tei:div.tei:p: karma pa sku phreng brgyad pa

mi bskyod rdo rje'i lo rgyus/ ༄༅/ /dpal karma pa na rim brgyad pa rje btsun mi bskyod zhabs ji ltar byon pa'i tshul ni/ de yang sngon tshe rje bdun pa'i zhabs de nyid rdo rje'i ting nge 'dzin g.yo ba med pa'i ye shes chen po'i rang snang dag pa'i zhing rab 'byams su sangs rgyas thams cad dang rgyal ba byams pas/ da lta dzam gling na sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i bstan pa lnga brgya tha ma la thug pas skye bo thams cad ngan song du gzhol bar gyur gyi de thams cad khyod kyis las nyon de dag kho na las brtsam ste/ gang 'dul du ston cig ces bskul ba na/ yid bzhin gyi snying po'i pad+ma 'dab ma 'bum pa la skyil mo krung gis bzhugs te/ khams sna tshogs pa 'dul ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs pa na dzam gling gi sems can thams cad kyi khams dang dbang po dang mos pa thams cad ji lta bar mkhyen 'dul dka' sla thams cad la'ang thugs mnyam pa nyid du gyur cing*/ de thams cad gdul bar nus par gzigs pas sangs rgyas thams cad la phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod sprin rgya cher spros te/ 'od zer mtha' yas pas sems cad thams cad smin par mdzad de/ bcom ldan dpa' bo khyod ni sngon sangs rgyas// dga' ldan bzhugs nas dzam gling gshegs 'tshal ltas// bdag la ma rungs 'dul ba'i lung mnos te// byang chub spyod pa'i mgon mdzad ngo mtshar to// ces sogs smon lam dang dam bca' chen po mdzad nas rdo rje'i mdzad pa bcu gnyis ji ltar mdzad pa la sogs pa rnams ni skal pa mchog gi spyod yul te/ rnam thar bdag tshul bcu gnyis pa las cung zad gsungs pa de skad kyang rgya mtsho las chu thigs tsam stsal bar zad de bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas dam pa'o// thun mong gdul bya'i snang ba dang bstun na/ rje chos grags rgya mtshos/ bdag ni skye ba med la skye tshul ston// gnas pa med la gnas tshul ston// 'chi ba med kyang 'chi tshul ston//

zhes sogs dang*/ sku skye ba phyi ma'i 'khrungs yul yab yum sogs gsal bar gsungs pa de ltar sku bltams pa'i gnas ni dpal karma'i gdan sa chen po dang nye ba ngom chu rgyud/ de las g.yas lung kar ti phug /de'i bye brag sa tam gyi grong du skye bo phal pa ltar snang ba'i yab yum la bltams par mdzad do// de yang rje nyid kyi zhal nas kho bo la phyi nang gsang ba'i pha ma yod de/ longs spyod rdzogs sku'i zhing du sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo hrīḥyig gi rnam pas gsang ba'i yab chos rje 'jig rten dbang phyug 'khor lo sdom par bzhengs pa'i zhal nas zhugs te yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma a sgron gyi lhums su zhugs pa ste/ 'di gnyis sa bcu'i byang sems yin la rnam pa g.yo sgyu'i mdzad pa ltar snang bas kho bo'ang mi gzhi ngan pa ltar snang ba yin/ de nas longs sku he ru ka'i rnam pas bltams te sngar sa hor gyis bod chol kha gsum bzung dus kyi dmag dpon chen po dgu pa'i rgyud las skyes pa gser bya bral byams pa bshes gnyen gyi zhal nas zhugs shing 'khrungs pa'i chu mig dang shug phung gi bdag mo klu mo da ra gsal sgron gyi lhums su babs te/ de'i rten 'brel gyis ngag cung zad mi bde ba dang spun zla rnams shes pa mi gsal ba yin/ nang gi pha ma 'di dag ni sngags kyi sbyor lam pa yul nyer bzhi thams cad du dngos su tshogs 'khor la dbang ba yin/ de ltar gsang ba dang nang gi lhums su rdo rje theg pa'i nang gi dbang bskur thams cad yongs su rdzogs te dag pa la sprul sku'i rnam pas nang gi yum gyi lhums nas bltams te phyi'i yab a byams dang yum sdong mkha' spyod pa'i dbon mo sdong bza' bla ma sgron gyi lhums su zhugs pa yin/ phyi'i yab yum 'di gnyis kyang sngags kyi tshogs lam chen po pa rmi lam du yul nyer bzhi rnams bgrod pa yin no zhes rje dpa' bo la dngos su bka' stsal to//

de yang me yos hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu'i srod la 'od kyi gong bu 'od zer 'phro ba zhig khang thog tu babs nas skar khung nas sil sgra dang bcas pas nang du song nas nang thams cad nyi ma shar ba ltar gsal ba zhig byung tshe lhums su zhugs te/ de'i nub yum gyi mnal lam du thang chen po me tog gis gang ba'i dbus na gur chen po shin tu legs pa sku gsung thugs rten ngo mtshar bas gang ba dung gi mchod rten kha ba ltar 'bab pa gcig tu son nas rus pa'i rgyan drug dang bcas te gar byed cing 'dug pa'i rgyab ri 'ja' gur dang na bun g.yu'i mdog gis gtibs pa khye'u bu mo bltar mi ngoms pa nor bu'i rgyan can mchod pa sna tshogs 'dzin pas phyi nas bskor ba dang*/ glu gar gyis mchod pa mthong zhing de'i tshe mchod gral nas gser gyi rdo rje 'od 'bar ba zhig blangs/ bud med ral pa kham sha re ba zhig gis dung chen po gcig 'bud cing 'dug pa'i dung blangs nas bus pas skad cher byung tshe khri thog na bla ma zhig 'dug pa na re/ dung skad de rgya dbus thams cad du thos nas thal zer/ phyi rol thams cad khrom gyis gang 'dug pa la yab kyis ma ṇi lag bskor chen po gcig thogs nas thams cad la ma ṇi bskul zhing 'dug /bla ma des dung gi mchod rten gyis mdo 'dzin byas pa'i phreng ba zhig yum rang la gtad nas 'di la ma ṇi sgrongs zer te/ 'dren bdo ba la mnal sad tshe/ lus bde nyams dang bcas pa'i sngar las ljid tsam zhig tu 'dug /de la sogs pa yab yum dang yul sde bcas la ngo mtshar ba'i ltas dang rmi lam dpag med byung 'dug pa brir ma longs shing*/ 'phags chen rnams lhums zhugs dang*/ bltams pa sogs kyi tshe/ ngo mtshar ba'i ltas bzang yong ba chos nyid yin pa'i phyir ro/ /de ltar lhums su zla ba brgyad lhag par bzhugs te lkog gyur gyi gdul bya mtha' yas pa'i don mdzad de/ hor zla bcu gcig pa'i yar tshes bzhi'i snga dror yum la gnod pa med par bltams te dri bzang gi ngad chen po byung ba na spyan hrig hrig mdzad nas karma pa'o zhes pa tsam gsungs/

de'i tshe khang thog tu 'ja'i ka ba zug /me tog gi char bab cing yum la zhag mang por dri bzang gi ngad bro ba byung*/ de'i tshe lha thams cad kyis snyan pa bsgrags pas skye bo'i tshogs mang po rang bzhin gyis 'dus shing ngom du karma pa'i sku skye 'khrungs zhes snyan pa phyogs thams cad du khyab/ karma si tu pa rgyal sras bkra shis dpal 'byor phyogs der phebs pa na/ zla ba de'i tshes bcu gsum la yab a byams mjal du byon pa nas ngad la byis pa ngo mtshar che ba zhig yod zhus pas/ sngar rje chos grags rgya mtshos ma 'ongs sprul sku lung bstan gyi shog dril si tu pa dang*/ rgyal tshab pa so sor gtod gsungs pa'i zhal byang yod pa rten sgam du bzhugs par zhib gzigs mdzad nas khyed yab yum la ming ci/ khang pa'i ltag 'og tu shug phung dang*/ chu mig sgo shar du bstan pa rnams e yod gsungs/ yod tshul zhus pas yab byams pa/ yum bla ma mtsho zer ba cung ma mthun/ 'on kyang a byams dang*/ bla ma sgron zhes phyogs mthun tsam yin pa 'dra/ sku tshe'i rten 'brel du zla ba gsum pa'i bar gsang la nya ra dam por gyis gsungs nas/ rten bsdus ril bu bdun/ ras kyi bag le kha gang*/ ja dang mar/ gu gul dkar nag 'dres pa phul gang tsam bskur nas/ 'di karma si tu pas na bza' dang ja 'dren yin zhus/ spos 'dis bdug pa gyis/ rten bsdus ril bu 'di rnams drongs dang*/ sprul sku yin na ci yang mi yong*/ min na nang par nas rtags gcig ston pa yin/ de'i tshe mang na tshig bzhi nyung na gsum gsungs pa yin/ de byung na khyod 'dir shog gsungs/ yab kyis de rnams byas pa na ja 'dren yang bag 'phyis tsam/ e ma ho/ nga la the tshom ma byed dang*/ /nga ni karma pa zhes bya/ /gzhan 'ga' yang gsungs pa ma zin/ /ja skol zhing yod tshe sprul sku bltams nas zhag bcu gsum lon pa de bzhengs nas gar mdzad/ /ngom stod kyi sdong lha rgod gyi bu mo dpon g.yog gnyis kyis mjal nyin 'ja' dang me tog gi char byung*/

thams cad mkhyen pa gong ma dngos dang mjal ba'i dad pa skyes/ sku 'khrungs nas zhag bco lnga na shel khyam dpon nya skyabs kyis/ nga'i phas drung gong ma sku chung dus na bza' zhig phul/ da res ngas kyang sku drung du na bza' zhig 'bul zhes phul bas legs so gsungs/ zla ba gcig na sgom chen gser phu bas mjal te khrom mang po yod sar ja zhus dang*/ tshogs 'khor byas/ phyag tu khong gi ḍā dril phul bas dgyes te 'khrol zhing thams cad la phyag dbang mdzad/ khyed karma pa yin na rtse lha sgang du nga la chos gnang ba de gang yin zhus pas/ phyag rgya chen po dang*/ nā ro chos drug yin gsung pa dang*/ drung si tu pas sprul sku brtag par yon bdag mtsho skyis btang tshe yig drug lan mang po gsungs dbu dum pa gser jis mjal bas sku la dri bzang gi ngad rgyun du ldang ba la sogs pa mtshan bzang gi snyan pa ri bo cher bsgrags shing*/ thams cad kyis karma pa'i sprul sku yin par yid ches nas snyan pas phyogs kun khyab/ a khu a thar gyis 'di karma pa yin na 'dis mi gnod zer nas sman chen zhun mar dang sbyar nas drongs pas/ cung zad kyang ma gnod/ byis pa legs so bya ba'i bu tsha des ldag li'i bu karma pa yin na cir thal yang byin rlabs zhu ri zhes kha ngan mang du byas nas yab dang sngon kha gal byas par khrom la phyag dbang gnang skabs der ma gnang pas kho rang yang dad/ yum gyis bal 'khal ba'i 'phang nas 'dzin te/ 'khal ma bcug pas/ khyod da lo mi kha rgyang grags zer nas 'gram par thal lcag rgyab pas/ a ma rang dal por sdod ma ṇi thon/ bal 'khel mi dgos/ nga la bdag po gcig myur du yong ba yod gsungs bzhin ri bo che ba dang*/ lho rong pa'i spyan 'dren pa slebs ltar/ zla ngo bdun bzhes pa na ri bo cher phebs/ chos rjes 'jig rten dbang phyug gis bsnyen bkur cher zhus/ ngos 'dzin mang po mdzad/ de nas bzung ste la lar bslab ston gnang ba dang*/

la lar mngon mkhyen mdzad pa/ la lar yig drug gi dge bskul mdzad pa la sogs pas skya ser thams cad dad pa thun mong ma yin pa skyes/ khams phyogs kyi yul mi thams cad nas rgyal ba karma pa'i sprul sku yin la yin bzhin par thag bcad/ chos rje yang thugs bla lhag tu ches nas/ chibs pa sku chas sogs rdzongs 'bul bcas lho rong rdzong du spyan drangs ltar phebs/ don ldan zhabs kyi dbu zhwa ngos 'dzin mdzad/ skabs der rgyal tshab pas sprul sku ngom du 'khrungs pa'i skad gsan 'phral rten 'brel 'grigs/ 'onakyang bla ma a mdo ba rgod rlabs can zhig gis kho rang tshang du bu zhig byung ba zur mang drung pa'i sku skye yin pas de ltar yin tshul gsungs pa dang*/ pha la rmi lam dang ltas bzang po byung bar brten/ bu la bslab sbyangs mang du byas nas thams cad mkhyen pa'i sprul skur bsgrags te brag gsum na bzhugs/ sgar pa phal cher yang dair 'dus pa la longs spyod kyis mgu bar byas/ bla ma rin po che skya se sgar du gdan drangs te sku skye ngos 'dzin mdzad par zhus pa bla ma nyid sku gshegs/ de'i tshe sgar pas phyogs lhung gis dkrugs rkyen gyis/ rgyal tshab pa sngon gyi lung bstan sogs kyis sprul sku nyid la 'chugs med kyi thugs nges shes yod rung re zhig sgar pa mi mang gi kha ngo cung zad gzigs dgos kyis brag gsum du phebs nas/ a mdo ba'i sras dang mjal bar dar sna tshur slog pa sogs rten 'brel ma 'grigs shing*/ a mdo'i sras re zhig rtse lha sgang du sku mtshams la bzhag mchog sprul lho rong rdzong du phebs sngon dbu zhwa dang las zhwa gzhan ma zhig la ngos 'dzin ji bzhin mdzad/ drung gong ma'i lcam sring zhig yod par a ces gsungs/ de sogs ngos 'dzin mang po gnang*/ ki nog bla ma bsod rin pas khyed karma pa yin na nga la gsung zhig byon zhus pas/ nga lan re pad+ma 'byung gnas yin/ lan re sa ra ha pa yin/

sogs gsungs dgung lo lnga pa la a mdo bu zur mang sku skye yin nga yi grwa pa yin gsungs/ rje mo zhig gis bsngo zhus phul bas bsngo ba ma gnang pas/ des sngar karma pa yin na gog mi yong zhus pa yin 'dug yum lha mo skyid ces dbon mo'o yum ngos 'dzin dang*/ rkang pa 'theng tshul mdzad/ rgya ston bya bral bas mjal/ mchod bsham gyi steng gi nam mkhar o rgyan chen po zhal gzigs/ sgar nas bla ma yang ri ba sogs spyan 'dren la 'byor/ de nas sprul pa'i sku'i zhabs phyir lho rong go shrī/ ri bo che'i mi sna rnams 'byon pa'i snga 'phar btang nas/ nam zla dgun yin yang 'brug dang khu byug lan gsum gsum du grags/ sgar dpon rnams sprul sku gnyis nges pa ma 'drongs kyi bar du phyag mi 'tshal ba'i khrims byas kyang*/ dbang med du snang ba 'gyur bas phyag dang mjal dar phul thams cad mchi ma dang bcas smon lam 'debs par gyur/ sgar du phebs thog snye bo gu shri sogs ngos 'dzin mang po gnang*/ de nas a mdo bu dang ngos 'dzin bsdur bas a mdo bus gser sku gcig dang thang ka gcig bzung bas de phyogs pas rta rgyug pa sogs byas pa na/ rgyal tshab par bud med dkar mo zhig gis dung chen po zhig khyer byung bar ngas dung 'di phyogs thams cad du bsgrags kyang khyod kyis tshag byed ma nyan zer/ bud med dmar mo zhig gis khyod rdzun ma'i ngag la nyan pa zhig zer ba rnams gzigs pa dang*/ lung pa de rnams lho rong pa dang*/ rgya ston pa'i mnga' zhabs yin pas/ sprul sku yin nges khri thog tu mi 'don na nub phyogs pa 'khor bcas med par byed zer nas dmag sogs la zhugs/ des sgar pa rnams skrag nas rgyal tshab pas gang gnang ba de ga yin zhus pa la brten/ sprul sku rin po che bya lo hor zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu bzhi'i nyin rgyal phur gyi 'grub sbyor la sgar thog tu seng ge'i khri chen por phebs te bkra shis kyi mnga' gsol ba mdzad/

sgar pa thams cad kyang thun mong ma yin pa'i dad pa skyes te/ sngar nged rang tsho de 'drar 'khrul pa ci byung ngam zhes gleng*/ skabs 'di yan chad lung bstan gyi tshan pa dang*/ zhwa dmar bzhi pa/ mnyan pa grub chen/ rgyal tshab rin po che sogs kyis gsungs brtag la ma brten par log pa kho na'i dbang du song tshul rje dpa' bos gsung par 'dir bri bar ma lang ngo*// de la dgung lo lnga pa dang drug pa'i skabs su rgyal tshab sogs rnams kyis sprul sku brtag par/ nga ni karma pa yin/ nga ni sa ra ha pa yin/ kho ni zur mang sprul sku ste/ nga'i slob ma yin gsungs pa dang*/ yang brtag par/ 'o na rtse lha sgang na 'das pa de yin nam/ rtsar gshis na 'das pa de yin zhus pas/ rtsar gshis na 'das pa de 'di yin gsungs te/ gsung 'dis brag gsum sku skye phyis zur mang sku skye chung tshang du gyur nas tsher lung gi bla ma mdzad pa yin no/ /spyir go shrī sogs kyi lan du bka' stsal pa/ stag lo dang yos lo'i bar bde ba can dang byams pa'i drung du bsdad pas skyid por byung*/ de nas rgyal ba byams pa'i bka' bzhin du 'dir 'ong ba yin/ dmu rgod kyis yid skyo ba byung zhes sogs gsungs so// 'di nas bzhugs khrir phebs pa dgung lo bdun pa la mngon mkhyen sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung tshul sa bon tsam brjod na/ bdag gis byang sham+bha lar song ste/ rigs ldan chos rgyal seng ge zhes bya ba seng khrir bzhugs te chos gsungs pa dang*/ mdun na 'don rnam gnon bzhugs pa yin zhes gsungs pa mtshur lugs kyi bstan rtsis dang 'grigs 'dug go /nga yi sprul pa bsam mi khyab/ da lta dbus gtsang na nga yi sprul pa bcu drug tsam yod/ nub phyogs na bod ston gcig yod pa nga rang dngos yin gsungs/

de nas gdan sa gong 'og kun tu gtam snyan gyi gser yig bkram/ bdag nyid chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mi bskyod rdo rje zhes pa'i mtshan btags pa/ 'khor yug gi bar du grags/ mgon po ber can dang*/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su grub chen karma pak+shi zhal gzigs/ gzhan yang*/ zhing skyong*/ dam can rnams zhal gzigs/ a mdo bas nga la mthu btang gi mgon po rgyug gsungs pa'i mod la kham pa tshang la nang 'thab byung*/ bkra shis sgang du ri gzigs la phebs par slob dpon pad+ma/ 'jam dbyangs dkar po/ sgrol ma/ mkha' 'gro lngas ḍā dril dang sil snyan 'dzin pa rnams gzigs/ pha wang zhig la zhabs rjes byon/ a la rong du 'jang bla ma bkra shis kyis rgyal po'i zhu yig sogs phul/ der rje mi la dang*/ ma mgon mgar gsum zhal gzigs/ gzhi bdag 'bar chung thod nag dge bsnyen mdzad/ der karma pak+shi dang*/ o rgyan pad+ma zhal gzigs/ drung gong ma'i sku thang la phyag nas zug yul bar du rnam sras zhal gzigs/ skabs der a mdo pha bu bshol kyang ma nyan par brag gsum du song bas chas ka rnams stor btson du tshud song*/ sa ga'i tshes bcu gsum la rgyal tshab rin po che bkra shis rnam rgyal las theg pa chen po'i bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa gsan/ chos kyi grags pa dpal bzang por mtshan gsol/ rta nag lcags ral can gyi dbang phul/ de nas yi ge 'dri klog sogs tshegs chung ngus mkhyen/ thang shing zhig rta mgrin lcags ral du gzigs/ mi la'i sku thang zhig dang*/ drung gong ma'i sku thang zhig la phyag nas zug po ti thang du dam can zhal gzigs/ drung pa'i mdun du phebs skabs ber can dang*/ rnam sras/ rdor legs/ sngags bdag rnams zhal gzigs/ bla ma gcod pa 'di rab tu byung dus/ nga zhwa nag gcig gyon nas der yod/ mkhan po drung pa go shrī yin/ khong tsho rab byung byed mi bcu yod gsungs pas drung pa dang bla ma gcod pa thugs ches/ drung pa kham spar thang du phebs/

bcu bzhi mchod pa mdzad tshe tshogs chang chur mdzad pas/ drung pa mnal yur skabs chos grags rgya mtsho'i gsung 'dra bas drung pa yar longs ma gnyid tshogs rdzas yong gi zer ba dang*/ dbu nas 'degs mkhan byung ba gzigs pas rje rang der bzhugs pa mjal/ chu thod por gnang byung ba a rag du 'dug cing 'thung bas bde ba skyes pa byung bas/ drung pas bdag rong po dpal thang du bcu bzhi mchod pa byed dus rje nyid gar bzhugs zhus pas/ bshad ma thag de rnams mdzad pa yin gsung pas drung pa rang la nges shes khyad par can 'khrungs/ bir wa pa dang*/ rta mgrin dregs pa kun sgrol/ ber nag can/ rnam sras/ dzam+bha la nag po/ spyan ras gzigs/ mgon po phyag drug pa rnams zhal gzigs/ rten sgrom na dus gsum mkhyen pa nas bzung gong ma rnams kyi dbu ljon yod pa rnams so sor ngos 'dzin gnang*/ mgon 'chams la g.yas skor g.yon skor 'di ci lags zhus pas chos grags rgya mtshos mdzad pa yin/ don ldan zhabs dus med gsungs/ sngar drung par las zhwa'i tog nas zung ma gyon gsung pa de yang gsungs/ gcod khrid phul dus 'di pusti dkar thung red/ glegs shing nang gi karma pak+shi'i sku 'di rje chos grags rgya mtsho'i phyag bris yin gsungs/ der dus mkhyen/ 'jam dkar/ rnam sras/ mgon po phyag bzhi pa/ slob dpon pad+ma/ bir+wa pa/ lwa ba pa rnams zhal gzigs/ po ti thang du spyang zhon mas karma pa'i bstan dgra rnams bsgral ba yin zer kyin rgyugs pa gzigs gsungs/ rngod du chos 'khor bkra shis gling gi dgon pa btab/ phyag nas gnang skabs gzhi bdag de gzigs/ 'bang chung thod nag gis char ser btang bar 'bang rje thod dkar zhes btags/ pha wang zhig la zhabs rjes byon/ yang drung gong ma'i sku thang la nas 'bru zug pa dang drung pa'i thugs dam thang ka rnams la phyag nas zug rgya ston nang so kun dga' rgyal mtshan pas spyan drangs/ 'bul zhabs cher byas/

dpon nam legs gdan sar bskos/ a khra la rnam rtog chos sku'i legs bshad mang po gnang bar mdzad/ lha gdan jo bo rin po che ji bzhin gzigs/ rdza dgon phur bzhugs nub dpal lha mo zhal gzigs/ bder gshegs phag gru dang*/ rdo na bzhugs skabs rje bdun pa/ 'khor lo bde mchog myur mdzad mgon po/ skyes bu chen po rnams zhal gzigs/ nang so seng ge ba la gnas lugs kyi ngo sprod ngo mtshar ba gnang ba dang rag zam khar sog gi dge bsnyen gzigs te gtor ma gnang*/ dga' ldan dgon du ku ku ri pa/ mgon po phyag bzhi pa/ myur mdzad mgon po rnams zhal gzigs/ thang dkar steng pa sde bcas a nu dmag dpon rgyal gyis phul nas dgon pa mdzad/ bkra shis sgang 'dogs pa gnang*/ ral brag lung du bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho/ dgyes rdor/ gsang 'dus/ mi bskyod pa/ sangs rgyas nyan thos kyi 'khor dang bcas pa zhal gzigs/ dpon nyi ma can nas na bza' dang mchod zhal ngos 'dzin mdzad pa dang*/ yul de'i btsan la chos gnang*/ nang so chos bzang pas tshang rag dgon du spyan drangs/ thang shing sgor mor mkha' 'gro ma grangs med kyis mchod pa dang*/ lha khang du bde mchog dang phyag bzhi pa dang*/ lha lung na ber nag can zhal gzigs/ 'o lung dgon du tai lo pa dang*/ o rgyan dang*/ sha mtha' gong dkar du gsang 'dus rigs lnga/ mgon dkar zhal gzigs/ dge bsnyen dbang lha 'od dkar gyis mjal/ rgyal tshab nas rje yi dbu lo bsil/ zur mang bya btang blo gros rgya mtsho dang*/ lha stong rgyal mtshan bzang po'i me tog ra bar ber nag can dang*/ rang byung ma zhal gzigs pa dang*/ sngon gyi zhing khams mang po dran tshul gsungs/ zur mang bya bral ba 'di skye ba mang po dran pa dang*/ rdo la zhabs rjes 'jog pa dang*/ sangs rgyas 'od srungs dang rje byams pa'i 'khor mdzad pa yin gsungs/ kho bo ri po ta lar phyin spyan ras gzigs dang*/ bde ba can du sangs rgyas 'od dpag med sku mdog ser po can/

dga' ldan du byams pa mjal/ de nas bdag rkye srid bzung ba yin gsungs/ nang don dang phyag chen gyi khrid gnang*/ rab 'byams pa phyogs glang dang yang ri bla ma slebs/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dang*/ rnam sras/ dam can rnams dang rje chos kyi grags pa zhal gzigs nas rdo rje gdan phyi rol pas bzung zer gsungs/ yum mā ma kī dang dregs pa skya gsum zhal gzigs/ de nas mdo khams shar phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur/ chu tshul la khar ber nag can dang*/ zhabs ye zam khar rang byung ma zhal gzigs/ de dgongs nyi zer steng du shākya thub pa mchog zung gnyis/ rnam sras dang*/ 'jam la rtsar ber nag can phyogs bcu mgon po bcas zhal gzigs/ ri bo che pas ja 'dren mdun bsu ring thung bcas gdan sar phebs/ sa ra ha dang tai lo nā ro pa rnams zhal gzigs/ lha khang du bzhugs gral btang pa spam zhwa dmar pa sogs la bla ma'i rnal 'byor sogs zab khrid gnang*/ rje bdun pa zhal gzigs nas 'phral yun gyi bslab ston mang po stsal/ lha khang bar khang gi thub sku la phyag nas zug de phyogs kyi mi sha sogs kha mchu thams cad bsdum/ mnal lam du mkha' 'gro sngon mo zhig gis/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i 'phrin las karma pa zhes sogs zhus pa rmis pa dang*/ chos grags dang phyogs glang zhal gzigs nas chos kyi bgro ba mang du mdzad pa'i mthar/ chos sku skye 'gag bral bas mnyam bzhag gtso/ /zhes sogs gsungs/ nyid kyi sku 'khrungs sa gzigs gsungs nas der tshogs gtor mdzad pa na/ mdun ri'i rtse na slob dpon pad+mas/ nga ni pad+ma 'byung gnas te/ khyod ni rgyal ba mchog dbyangs so/ /dbyer med rdo rje 'chang chen yin zhes gsungs pa gsan/ sa sgrang yon mchod kyis bsu ba'i tshe ra khyu zhig phyag phyir bkag ma thub par 'brangs pa la sngon gyi mi ma yin 'dul 'phro rnams glags ltar byung ba la dam can bran du bkol nas tshar bcad pa yin gsungs/ sa sgang gi gdan sa la bstan pa rgyal mtshan bskos/

de dag tu mgon po phyag drug pa dang ber nag can yang zhal gzigs/ zas mdar ber nag can zhal gzigs/ bstan pa skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes/ re rne dgon du dus mkhyen mjal/ der dpal ldan bkra shis bskos/ rje don ldan zhabs sku bltams gnas ngom shel khyam du phebs/ tshogs 'khor mdzad/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan bskos/ yong tsher thang du rgyal ba byams pa las byams chos gsan/ lha steng ba'i thab bsu'i skabs dam can bsu mar byon pa gzigs/ lha steng du byams pa dang 'gro mgon phug tu ras chen gzigs/ sram ko thang du byang stag rna ba'i dge 'dun sum brgya tsam gyis mjal bar gsung chos gnang*/ 'og min karmar phebs/ lha dang mi'i bsu ba'i bkod pas mdun bstar/ der rje dus mkhyen dang*/ ras chen pa/ mkhas pa dbang rdor sogs zhal gzigs/ dgu gtor skabs ma mgon zhal sbyor dang*/ zhing skyong zhal gzigs/ gying thang pa dang karma ba'i 'khrug pa bsdum par mdzad/ de nas mdo khams mchod rten mthong grol du phebs/ po ru ba sogs kyis mjal/ dgung lo brgyad la zur mang du phebs/ zur mang bde chen rtser bka' brgyud bla ma rnams zhal gzigs/ sman chu dgon dang snying thang du phebs/ tshang sar gu shrī bkra shis rgya mtsho sogs kyis mjal/ spyi 'byams rang byon rnams mjal/ zhabs rjes gcig byon/ bdud rtsi dil dang ru dgon du phebs/ nang chen gu shrī sangs rgyas grags pa dang*/ go shrī bsod nams bzang po'ang byung*/ nang ya gnyis kyi kha mchu rnams chod rgya mdzad/ tsar gshis su phebs/ sgrol ma brag rtsar sgrol ma'i lha tshogs rnams gzigs/ rtsi dur phebs/ skyob pa rin po che zhal gzigs/ chu mtsho gshongs su kyu ra dge 'dun seng ges gdan drangs/ sde gu dgon du phebs/ rje sangs rgyas mnyan pa dang dul mo bkra shis 'od zer ba phebs pas mjal/ lcags mo nang so 'od zer ba yang phebs/ rje de dag la mi phyid pa'i dad pa 'khrungs nas rjes su 'dzin par gsol ba btab par mdzad/

der rtag mgo rten gdan drangs pa mjal/ a gro rdzong dkar dang 'bom mkhar mgor phebs/ dran thang du gzhi bdag gis dar dkar phul ba nang par dngos su yod/ 'dan ma grub chen pas byang chub gling du spyan drangs/ zhwa khra can stong phrag lha tsam gyis bsu ma mdzad/ spungs ri nang so dang 'jang gi 'bul skyel ba rnams slebs/ sngar gyi grwa bsgres rnams ngos 'dzin gnang*/ tre khang dmar du phebs/ lcags mo bas 'bul chen phul/ rtse lha sgang nas drung gong ma'i sku 'khor lhun grub byon/ chibs sga nyi shar sogs phul/ shel khog tu phebs/ shar kha'i rol chen bco brgyad kyi mi sde rnams tshogs/ de nas stag bzang nang*/ shug ri thang rnams su phebs/ khrom khri dpon gyis spyan drangs khrom ri mtho sna'i dgon dang khrom sbrul lce snar phebs/ lcags mdud bla ma/ ka thog nang so dpal 'bar nang so/ nyag rong mtsho khab sogs kyis mjal/ der pho brang nas gdan 'dren gyi gser yig pa 'ong ba'i zhu yig dang*/ snam sbyar gser ma/ ta hu nga'i chos gos sogs khyer nas bla ma bsod rin pa sleb/ rgyal tshab drung du ja sig brgya nyer lnga sogs bskur/ rnam rgyal dgon gyi chos khrims sogs bcas/ nyag rong mtsho khar phebs/ mtsho dkyil du mgon po la phyogs bcu mgon pos bskor ba gzigs/ shar phyogs spungs rir phebs/ rje karma pak+shi'i gram gdan rdo gcig la gcig 'byar ba la sangs rgyas mnyan pa'i phyag rjes yod pa dang*/ mgon po'i zhabs rjes mjal/ karma pak+shi la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyis bskor ba dang*/ mgon po la phyogs bcu mgon pos bskor ba zhal gzigs/ 'dam chen rtse rang phebs/ mtsho nang du khros nag lha lnga zhal gzigs/ po 'bor gyi gzhi bdag rnams kyis mjal zhabs rjes kyang byon/ 'ba' stag mgo dang 'ba' thang du phebs/ go 'jo stong dpon dang be ri stong dpon pas mjal/ de nas kam̐ po gangs rar phebs/ ka ka ri phug 'ja' tshon gling*/

chos 'byung gong 'og rnams su zhabs rjes re byon/ bla ma bsod rin pa rgya yi gdan 'dren pa rnams sar mngags/ mchog rab dgon du phebs/ ngo khro lung pa ba rnams kyang der 'dus/ phag gsum gyis spyan drangs/ stag rgyal 'bar la phebs/ 'jang rgyal po'i gdan 'dren pa byung*/ de nas rim par rgyal thang du phebs/ yang 'jang gi gdan 'dren pa rnams slebs/ phebs par zhal gyis bzhes/ phyag nas gnang ba sa tham du slebs/ de nas ṛm par phebs/ byi lo sa ga'i tshes gsum la 'brug grags/ ri thams cad ngur/ 'ja' 'od kyi dra ba bres/ me tog gi char babs glang po che thag pa bcad nas sgar du phyin te phyag 'tshal ba sogs byung*/ ja kra bzhis gtsos dmag mi khri tsho tsam gyis bsu ba dang bcas sa tham pho brang gi nye skor du sgar phab/ phyi nyin tho rangs rgyal po nyid gyam khrir phebs/ rgyal po'i khu bo dang nu bos glang po che re re zhon/ glang po gcig yan par khrid/ rta kha dog sna tshogs pa'i zhon pa can/ gdugs rgyal mtshan rol mo sog kyis bkod pa bsam las 'das pa bcas byon/ gur sgor thams cad babs/ phyag phul/ la kha tsha smyon gyi lo tsā byas/ sku khams zhus/ 'bul ba phul/ glang po ches phyag phul zhing skad chen po btang*/ 'o thang 'bum gyis glang po ches skad 'don pa'i rgyu mtshan dris pas/ glang rdzis sangs rgyas byon pa la kho dga' ba red zer/ 'ja' dang me tog gi char babs/ nub re bzhin sgar mtha' nas rol mo phul/ rgyal por sangs rgyas dang drung gong ma'i gser sku/ mdo sde pad dkar rgya par/ rgyal ba'i ring bsrel/ rgyal lag bse ru/ gser chas/ chibs pa sogs skyos mar phul/ bsu ba'i bkod pa dang rje nyid 'gyogs khrir spyan drangs nas dpon slob rnams pho brang du spyan drangs/ rgyal po yang rgya sgo bar mar byon nas mjal dar phul/ rgya ban rol cha thogs pa dang*/ rnga bo che gcig la mi bcu drug gis 'then dgos 'dug

rdo chal du gser gyi nor bu ka ba gnyis kyi khyon tsam dang gser gyi rgyal srid sna bdun sogs dang*/ ri dwags tshon gyis kha bsgyur ba rnams la phyag nas zhus/ pho brang du gser khrir bzhugs su gsol/ 'khor rnams la'ang khri dang rgya khrir bzhugs nas/ mdun lcogs rnams gser dngul gyi me tog gis brgyan nas/ gsol ja zhu ba dang sbrag pa'i rin chen gos dar sogs brgya 'bul phul/ gsol chas sna tshogs pa zhus/ yang pho brang gcig tu gsol chas zhus/ gser dngul gyi phung po rnams 'dug par phyag nas zhus/ btsun mo gsum gyis rgyan rnams phul nas sems bskyed gnang*/ rgyal pos skyel ma bcas sgar thog tu phebs/ phyi nyin yang de ltar pho brang gcig tu spyan drangs/ lo bcu gsum bar bod la dmag mi byed pa dang*/ lo star bzhin bu khral lnga brgya re phul/ dgon pa brgya 'debs par khas blangs/ zhag bdun bzhugs/ de yan chad du 'jang rgyal po 'di sangs rgyas kyi bstan la mi gus pa zhig yin cing*/ de nas bzung rgyal bstan spyi dang kar bstan la mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob/ la kha bar rgyal pos dmag dang bcas pas bskyal/ lo bdun mtshams nas phebs par zhal gyis bzhes/ bu khral 'bul ba sogs star chags su byas/ de nas rgyal thang khang sar mgor phebs zhabs kyis bcags te dgon pa btab/

de nas rim par phebs rje grags seng pa sku 'khrung sar tshogs 'khor mdzad/ stag lung pa'i dgon rdza gog du phebs/ ldob rnams kyis mjal/ dus mkhyen gyi sgrub gnas spang phug tu phebs/ sku 'dra gsung byon ma mjal/ der dus mkhyen zhal gzigs/ byin gyis brlab par mdzad/ de nas li thang du spyan drangs/ sa ser dgon du phebs/ sri dkar nang so chos dbang sogs gong ma'i grwa pa rnams ngos 'dzin gnang*/ de tshe rgyal tshab sprul sku snye bor gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs rgya cher mdzad/ dge 'dun rnams la gser zho 'gyed/ dbus su spyan sngar 'bul chen dang*/ gdan sa gong 'og sogs su'ang 'bul bskur mdzad/ snye bor gdung rten bzhengs pa'i rgyu bcas gser zho lnga brgya/ ja lnga bcu/ zangs dos bcu sogs bskur/ thub chen gser thog rgyu zangs dos sum cu/ gser zho stong rwa can/ ja brgya/ rta drel mdzo g.yag mang po sogs bskur/ mkhas pa mi lngas ja 'dren slebs rab sgang du spyan drangs/ 'gom sgang du phebs/ 'bul zhabs zhus/ nyag rong gru khar dpon dgra lha rgyal sogs la dad rten zhabs rjes zhig bzhag chu pha ri phag mo ri la zhag gcig bzhugs/ sgrub phug tu phyag sor gsum gyi rjes byon/ mi nyag 'jam dbyangs grags pa dang rje don ldan zhabs kyi gdan sa dza lan+dha rar phebs/ rje yab sras kyi sku 'dra sogs la mchod 'bul mdzad/ mkhas pa mi lnga'i dgon bka' bzhi dgon du phebs/ gos can gyi phyar bu can dge 'dun stong phrag gis bsus/ lto mgo rin chen gling du phebs/ gos chen phyar bu can dge 'dun brgyas bsus/ de nas zhwa dmar spyan snga rin po che ni sa thag gis bskal pas gdan ma grub/ drung gong mas si tu par yi ge gnang bar grub chen sangs rgyas mnyan pa bla mar 'os zhes 'dug pa dang*/ rje nyid sku chung ngu nas nga'i bla ma ni 'dan ma grub chen yin gsungs pa sogs kyis rje sangs rgyas mnyan pa rigs bdag tu spyan drangs nas bka' chos gsan tshul rnams legs spyad ma'i 'grel pa ltar las/

de yang byi lo zla ba bcu gcig par rje de'i drung nas dge tshul mdzad/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa sogs 'dul ba'i skor rnams gsan/ shing rta'i srol 'byed gnyis kyi sems bskyed zhus/ byang sa dang spyod 'jug sogs spyod phyogs kyi skor rnams gsan/ 'dus pa sdom pa sogs rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang rgyud bshad man ngag dang bcas pa/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang sbyor ba yan lag drug gi rnal 'byor phyag rgya chen po lhan cig skyes sbyor dang*/ nā ro chos drug gi zab khrid sogs gsan/ de nas be'u phug kho mo khre/ byams sar/ ta ti dga' ldan gling rnams su phebs/ zhing gi tā zhing rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyis dar rtse mdor spyan drangs/ mi rigs sna tshogs khri phrag du mar chos 'brel gnang*/ la mo rtser gzhi bdag mched lngas mjal dge bsnyen mdzad/ rgyal rong nas ro rnam gu shri dang*/ tsha ldog gu shri mjal/ der zla ba gcig la bzhugs/ tā zhing sogs de phyogs rnams kyis 'bul zhabs rgya cher phul/ de nas rab sgang char sgang la phebs/ glang lo'i lo sar mdzad/ rje sangs rgyas mnyan par 'bul chen bstabs/ grub chen nas kyang tshur 'bul chen phul/ 'dra yul du phebs/ tsher lung du dgon pa btab/ 'dra bla chos 'od bla mar bskos/ de nas lhun po rtse'i 'dabs su zla ba gnyis la bcad rgyar bzhugs/ rdo rol gtsang chen du phebs/ dge 'dun mang pos bsu ma byas/ 'dzir ka lha mo dar thang dang*/ 'dzam thang du phebs/ tar sku rin chen grags pa tshe mtshams las langs te dge 'dun stong phrag lhag gis bsu ma dang nam mkha' 'ja' 'od dang me tog gis khyab/ rta stong phrag sogs phul/ lcags rir phebs/ dom tsha nang so dang 'gu log dbon po/ gangs pa bstan pa sogs mgo log pa'i lha sde mi sde kun dang*/ pad+ma ri mtho nas a yam bla ma sogs rma rol sngo rol gyi dad 'dus rnams dang btsan la rgyal po'i 'bul skyel ba rnams kyis mjal/

gong ma'i mdun nas gdan 'dren pa rnams khro ching hur sleb/ sgar pa dbus su ma 'byon zer ba'i gser yig pa dom tsha hu tsing byung*/ rgya sor ja 'dren pa rnams brdzangs/ de nas pho de gar ka nas gling tshang gis gdan drangs/ tsi nang du 'phags pa klu sgrub zhal gzigs/ ba zis mdor zla gcig bzhugs/ mgo zi ri khrod du phebs/ gling drung pa ting 'dzin bzang por lung bstan mang po mdzad/ sog yul du spyan drangs kyang da res dus la ma babs gsungs/ 'dan byang chub gling du phebs/ sangs rgyas mnyan pa nas sgar pa stong phrag lhag la phog phul/ 'grus sgang chos rje dang lcags mo go shrī 'od zer bzang po la lung bstan mang po gnang*/ zan bshi nang du dpon rgyal yes mjal/ nu bo grwa par phul/ de nas smar khams su phebs/ ga zi dgon du sngon gyi lo tsā rnam gsum gyi rten rnams mjal/ su g.yag gzhung gsum dang mtha' bzhir phebs/ rdo ba bcang ba'i phyag rjes byon/ skyo mda' dgon dang yor gshis brgyud/ 'og min karmar phebs/ tā'i si tu bsod nams rnam rgyal gdan sar bskos/ mchod khang rnams la mchod rdzas du ma phul/ 'dus sder mang 'gyed mdzad/ der nang chen zur mang ri bo che pa rnams kyi ja 'dren byung*/ cham gshis nas/ snying thang du phebs nang tshang gnyis nas 'bul zhabs rgya cher zhus/ rgya so nas ja 'dren pa rnams 'khor/ zhu yig rten bzang bcas 'dug karmar phebs/ tha'i kyan chen pos brdzangs pa'i mi dpon rgya dpon las tshan can lnga brgya skor slebs nas gong du phebs pa'i zhu nan byung*/ 'dan ma skya yu dang gser yig pa gzhan rnams rgya sor btang*/ si tu bkra shis dpal 'byor gyi sku skye chos kyi 'od zer la sga shubs stan dmar sogs gnang*/ de ltar lo gsum du nyin mtshan bar med du dbang lung dang gsan sbyangs nyams khrid mdzad pas gsan pa mthar phyin 'dan ma grub chen shin tu dgyes/ da ni kho bo shi yang mi 'gyod gsungs pas/

yos lo zla ba dang por rje sangs rgyas mnyan pa chos dbyings su gshegs pas mchod 'bul rgya cher mdzad/ gsol ba btab pas lha chen gyi dpung pa g.yas steng du sangs rgyas mnyan pa phebs zab rgyas kyi chos tshul du ma gsungs par mdzad/ de nas bzung dul mo bkra shis 'od zer bsten par mdzad pa yin no/ /dom tsha hu tsi sogs gong nas gser yig pa mang po mu ti 'gram la sleb par ja 'dren pa btang*/ nyi steng duphebs/ lha khang du byams pa'i sku la phyag nas gnang bar nas bre gsum la bre bdun du 'phel/ nas 'bru mang po zug mu ti 'gram du dom tsha hu tsing*/ rgya dpon dgu sogs gser yig pa rnams kyis mjal/ mu tig gi snam sbyar dang gser yig dang 'ja' sa sogs phul/ dom tsha hu tsis/ nged rgya nag tu rta 'bul la song dus bdag brdzu ma red gsungs nas btson du chud skabs gong nas gser khang du rje nyid zhal gzigs/ sangs rgyas yin na zhabs la 'khor lo sogs yod thang bsam pa na phyag zhabs kyi mthil la 'khor lo'i ri mo yod pa bstan/ de 'dra'i bkod pa can gyi gser sku rgya nag ma rgyab yig tu sum cu so gnyis zer ba'i rgya yig yod pa 'ga' re yong*/ bya tshe ring la bya tshe ring khri phrag mang pos bskor pa gzigs pas btson las thar/ rgyal po'i lung gis mdun du phyin chog pa byung*/ bya tshe ring 'di 'dra bod du yod dam gsungs pas med tshul dang*/ rje'i rnam thar zhib tu dris byung bas sngar gyi gong ma rnams dang karma pa yon mchod yin tshul sogs zhus pas/ nged la hu tsi rgyal sras pa'i las ka gnang ba yin cing*/ der nyi ma nub phyogs na 'od dpag med kyi sprul sku nged kyi don du byon pa de spyan 'dren pa yin zhes pa'i dril bsgrags song zhes zer/ de nas gtsang gshis rdo rje gro lod du phebs/ gu ru mtshan brgyad zhal gzigs/ drung gong ma'i phyag mkhar rjes mjal/ der zhabs rjes zhig kyang byon/

kaṃ po dpal brtsegs kyis dar dkar phul/ rngu chur bai ro tsa na'i gnas sgo phyes/ der yang zhabs rjes byon/ nyug rum pa gnyis sogs sa ser nas slebs par ja 'dren btang*/ li thang du phebs/ dom tshas rgyal ba rigs lnga'i si thang lnga sogs dang*/ ding phon/ gser dngul shel spyad sogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang*/ rgyal tshab sogs la'ang brgya tshan ra sogs dang*/ kar dgon so so'i mang 'gyed rten la sogs pa dpag tu med pa phul/ de nyin nam mkhar 'ja' 'od dang*/ me tog gi char babs/ byams pa 'jam dpal/ bka' brgyud bla ma rnams dang*/ ma mgon dam can rnams gzigs/ rgya rnams kyis gsol ston drangs/ nyag chu khar phebs mnyan pas gru gla brtsad pas zhag gnyis thog sngar ye mi dar ba'i zla ba bcu par sa rong tshad pa'i yul der chu la dar chags nas sgar pa rgya 'grul bcas 'gro chog pa byung*/ de mtshams nas dar yang zhig song*/ der rdo la zhabs rjes byon/ drung nyid nam mkha' la 'phur te byon pa rgya bod kun gyis mjal/ 'dra yul tsher lung dgon du phebs/ 'brug lo'i lo sar mdzad/ ba thang shing gi gnas su rigs gsum mgon po dang*/ byams pa dang rdo rje phag mo zhal gzigs/ rdo la zhabs rjes byung*/ dbus nas spyan snga rig 'dzin sogs ja 'dren pa rnams slebs par drung khri dpon sar rje gong mas nged rang gnyis 'brug lor 'phrad gsungs pa'i nges shes thob/ seng ge dgon du karma pak+shi'i sku mjal/ me tog gi char babs/ sku 'dra dang mol mchid mdzad/ tha'i cin chen po snya lo mgor phebs skabs ja 'dren pa btang*/ der tha'i cen sogs kyis karma pa zhwa nag can zhal nub la gzigs pa mjal/ ra ti dga' ldan gling du phebs/ tha'i cen chen pos mjal/ de yang btsun mo'i 'khor nyug rum pa'i ming yin/ gong ma'i lung gis khyod gdan 'dren la yongs nas lo 'ga' song da myur du pho brang du phebs dgos zhus/ phyi nyin tha'i cin gyam khri la zhon te tha'i cin brgyad/

tā zhing brgya/ khri dmag bcas byung bas mjal/ pus btsugs thal sbyar gyis gong gi 'ja' sa bsgrags song*/ de yang nyi ma nub phyogs na lha rang byon chos rje'i drung du/ lus spos chus bkrus/ pus mo sa la btsugs nas zhu ba/ nged karma pa snying nas 'dod pa la skam pa chu 'dod pa ltar/ khyed dang nga las 'phro yod pas/ la chen chu chen rnams la rdzu 'phrul gyis byon shog zhes sogs 'dug de nas nyi ma re bzhin blon po so so dang*/ btsun mo/ rgyal bu/ rgyal bu gzhan rnams dang bla mchod so so'i 'bul ba dang zhu yig rnams phul/ dus der phul ba'i dngul kong dang dngul gyi spos phor sogs sngar dus mchod bsham du yod skad 'dug go /rgya mi'i dos sgam dmar tham 'byar brgya sogs dos khri tsho gsum dang bdun brgya sogs slebs/ gser yig pa rnams kyis 'bul chen rgyab/ rta rgyugs rtse sna sogs gzigs phul/ rje yi zhal nas/ kho bo'i ltas la nyi zla cha gnyis shar nas gling bzhi 'od kyis khyab pa la/ nyi zla cha gcig sar lhung ba byung bas da lan nged mi 'gro gsung pas dom tsa hu tsi yul du song*/ gser yig pa rnams shin tu ma dga' nas phyir song*/ 'bul ba rnams ma phul bas/ lam bar du rgyu chas rnams gzhan gyis phrog gong ma yang gnam du gshegs/ nyug rum pa de yang las tshan babs/ gong ma cing do rgyal po de karma pa chos grags rgya mtsho'i sprul pa yin pa kho rang gis dran te dbu la karma pa'i zhwa nag 'di 'dra zhig gyon nas nga karma pa yin gsungs pa zhig yod 'dug cing*/ nyug rum pas 'bul ba byed pa'i tshe rje nas drung gong ma dang gong ma cing de rgyal po gnyis yang yang gzigs/ de dus nas gong ma gnam du gshegs tshar ba yin 'dug karma na bzhugs skabs dus mkhyen sku 'dras da res rgya yul du ma byon gsungs pa dang*/ thugs rje chen pos kyang gong ma la sku tshe med par gsungs pa yin 'dug go/ rje brgyad pa khri 'don phyi bshol du song bas mchod yon gyi rten 'byung 'dzol ba yin 'dug go

/phyag mdzod dang gser yig pa bgros nas rje nyid btsan thabs su spyan 'dren par brtsam pa na/ rje nyid drung 'khor nyung bsdus bcas bod du gsang thabs kyis chibs bskyod gnang*/ phyis phyag mdzod kyang sku chas rnams zad nas kong por sleb par gyur/ tom ta dgon du phebs/ a tsa ra zhig gis rde'u gyo tshal sogs mang po mdun du spungs te phul ba rten 'byung legs po yin pa la/ khrims pas gtor/ sgar gyi thad ri rtse nas bud med gcig gis skad btang byung bar ltar btang nas sog dmag mang po byung bas/ de ma thag tu sgar bteg de nub drung nyid dang chibs kha ba dang*/ ā tsar+ya ma gtogs ma sleb/ ā tsaṣa'i phyi la bud med bzhi yod pa chibs kha bas mthong*/ ā tsaṣa de mi tra dzo gi yin 'dug /sgar du lan gsum tsam byon nas gdams ngag mang po zhus gsung 'dug /lhun po rtser dbyar bzhugs dang*/ sbrul lo'i lo sar mdzad/ dus mkhyen 'khrungs sa dang*/ rag stag sku 'bum mjal/ 'dzin rnam rgyal dang*/ spa spong dgon du phebs/ mchod khang du byon/ gsol chas dang 'bul ba phul tshe me tog gi char babs/ karma pak+shi sku 'khrungs pa'i gnas cag tor phebs/ mtsho ke mdor a gro ban bon sde dgon gyis mjal/ 'or lar karma'i dpal shes mjal/ khyed rgya nag du ma byon pa legs/ rgya 'dre rnams dang nged tsho rab sgang du 'khrugs nas nged rnams rgyal ba yin zhus/ karmar phebs rang byung ba'i sgrub gnas brag dmar la zla mtshams mdzad/ snying thang du tshang gsar pas spyan drangs/ ri khag rnams kyis mjal 'bul zhus/ zur mang du spyan drangs 'bul zhabs mdzad/ ri bo cher phebs/ lha khang du gdan drangs/ rgyab rir thugs rje chen po zhal gzigs/ mkhan slob rnams la chos kyi mol mchid mdzad/ lho rong rdzong sar du phebs/ 'o lung du lho rgyud kyi grwa slob thams cad kyis mjal/ rgya ston bya bral bas spyan drangs 'bul zhabs bstabs/ lcags tur dgon pa btab/

re rgyab dgon du ye shes mgon po sogs zhal gzigs/ tsan dan dgon du dge 'dun stong rwa can gyis ser sbreng gis bsus/ 'ja' dang me tog gi char kha ba tsam nyin zhag bco lngar babs/ me tog 'dab stong can yu ba nas bzung thub pa du ma byung*/ de phyogs kyi sha 'khon rnams bsdum par mdzad/ lcags zam dge bsnyen la go khrab sogs rten rdzas gnang*/ slar yang dge bsnyen mdzad/ der bka' brgyud bla ma rnams dang ma mgon sogs zhal gzigs/ spang thang rnams la phyag nas gnang bas zhing sa bzang por gyur/ mgo zlar khyung thol brgal bas nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyis khengs/ sangs rgyas mnyan pa zhal gzigs/ khyung tho dge bsnyen gyis slar dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa zhus/ phu lung du phebs rten rnams mjal/ lug lo'i lo sar mdzad/ de mo la phebs/ byams chen gyi thugs kar phyag nas mang po zug lta ba tshal khung du bzhugs/ khro rgyal gyis rta brgya/ nam mkha' skor bas rta brgya/ ri bo gser gling pa sogs kyis rta brgya sogs phul/ 'khrugs rtsod thams cad bsdum/ rnam thos tshal dang rtse lha sgang du phebs/ karma'i dbon brgyud pa drung rdo rje gzhon nus sku gsung thugs rten rgya hor gyi spyad pa mang po dang*/ bu chu bas rta brgya sogs phul/

de nas rnam thos kyi ri bor phebs/ rje gong ma chos grags rgya mtsho zhal gzigs/ rten gan+dho la/ zhwa nag gser gyi 'ja' sa sogs drung gong ma'i sku chas rnams phyag bzhes gnang*/ gyi ling tshal du sgar btab/ dbus nas tre chen pa dang*/ ngo khro rab 'byams pa byon pas mjal/ drung khrims dpon pa gshegs/ lkog 'phrang du slob dpon pad+ma dang rang byung rdo rje dang bka' brgyud bla ma rnams zhal gzigs/ rdo la zhabs rjes byon/ klu zha rta mgyogs su bshad grwa btsugs/ ngo khro rab 'byams pa slob dpon du bskos/ rgyal 'dzin stod smad kyi zhal lce rnams bsdum/ ban sgar nang so bstan pa rgya mtsho thub chen gyi 'dzin skyong la bskos/ rnam thos ri bor chos skyong gi gtor sgrub mdzad/ mdzod nag gi sgo phyes nas gzigs rtog gnang*/ rtse lha sgang gi ri khrod btab/ der 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa zhal gzigs/ ma 'ongs mtha' 'khob du 'gro don 'byung bar lung bstan/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'khor bcas zhal gzigs/ sgrub sder mkhan chen shākya bzang po bla mar bskos/ gyi ling tshal du gser gling bla ma chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis nyid kyi rnam thar zhus pa la/ bdag ni chung ngu'i dus nas kyang*// 'dod yon rmi lam sgyu 'drar rig/ bdag ni nges 'byung kun slangs nas// so thar gser gyi bum pa ni// nyes ltung dri mas gos pa med// sems bskyed pad+ma dkar po la// rang don ba mos ma gos so// rdo rje theg pa'i shing rta la// tha mal rnam rtog rdul gyi 'tshubs// skad cig tsam yang mi snang ngo*// zhes sogs gsungs/ bla ma ru pa dang kre chung bas 'bul chen zhus/ spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa'i ja zhus zhu yig bla ma gdan sa pa dang dpon po chos skyong g-is phul/ 'di'i dus spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa dpon slob mthun sbyor ltar snang ba 'gal rkyen rnams kyi gnas tshul yang mkhyen pas zhal mjal bar ches bzhed cing*/ slar yang dbon po chos skyong ba nas gnang bar/

sngar nged rang gi las dbang gis phyi ma mjal ma thub pa la sems 'gyod par yod/ da nga rang gis gdan 'dren gyi dngos gzhi byed/ cis kyang phebs pa zhig zhu/ phebs lam yang yang klungs phyogs 'di la gnang na nged thil gyi go sa 'dis thil pa'i las tshan bsgrig dgos zer nas/ dang po 'dra ba zhig las mi 'ong bas nyang kha phyogs 'di la phebs par zhu/ brag gsum du nga rang rgan po gdan 'dren la yong*/ mar la lugs kyang dbu'i byin rlabs tsam gnang ba 'dug na nga bod yul gyi ban+de'i rgan mgor 'dug pas mi 'gal mod/ ched du zhu rgyu ni min/ gzhan nged rang sgar pa'i srol dkar yol gyi shubs thag mdzub mo la gon/ gding ba khyer nas yong pa yin pas gnang dka' gtan mi dgos/ 'bri stag chos rje zhal bzhugs 'di thams cad nged rang gi slob ma kho na yin pas 'di dag kyang dka' ba med par zhal slob tu tshud pa zhig 'ong*/ 'di ltar min na 'di tshos kyang mjal 'phrad kyi dka' gnas ci zhu mi shes/ phebs rjes nga rang gi dgon gnas mchod gzhis yon bdag slob ma thams cad drung nyid du 'bul/ zhes gsungs pa'i zhu yig do gal can phul na'ang*/ sgar dpon rnams kyi bka' gros la de lta na chos gsan pa 'char zhing de mi legs pa'i bka' gros byung ste/ sku dbang ma 'dus pa'i tshul gyis bka' shog nang ma yang gnang*/ de nas mi ring bar spyan snga thams cad mkhyen pa'ang sku zhing du gshegs so/ /chang dong sgang du bzhugs tshe rta dpon dkon mchog rgyal mtshan shi ba'i sngas su phebs te 'pho ba gnang*/ nga ni skye rga na 'chi 'di// mthong ba tsam gyis snying rlung 'phyo// khrom dung phyur bsags pa'i nang shed na// rgan po stong yang rnyed mi 'gyur// zhes sogs mgur mdzad/ rgyal gong lhum brag sogs su dbus gtsang nas mjal mi dang dge 'dun nyis stong tsam la mdo sde dran nye sogs gnang*/ gzims dpon 'dan go shrī 'da' khar spyan drangs phyag rdzas rnams rtsis phul/

mtshams sbyor bzang po'i bka' gnang ste lhar skye bar lung bstan/ ngo khro rab 'byams pa khams 'gro sa gnang*/ 'jang dang spu 'bor du karma pa'i bstan pa dar bar byas/ mtshur phu ba nyi ma bkra shis kyis mjal te chos mang po zhus/ skabs der 'jam dpal smra seng pan chen zi lung par gnas gyur pa dang*/ rong ston gnyis shin tu dgyes pa'i tshul bcas phebs byung zhes dang*/ jo nang pa rong ston gnyis shin tu dgyes bzhin par yang yang mjal gsungs/ tshe sgrub zla ba gsum mdzad pas tshe dpag med zhal gzigs/ 'khor la thugs ma sun na ji 'dod du bzhugs chog pa'i lung bstan byung*/ bu chu na bzhugs thog rgyal tshab sprul sku sgar du spyan drangs/ dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa gnang*/ gtsug phud dor/ mtshan grags pa dpal 'byor du gsol/ mgon po ber nag can beng thogs pa zhal gzigs/ stag lung pa sogs byang ris mang por jo bo'i gsung sgros sogs kyi bka' chos gsungs/ de nub rmang lam du rin po che'i khri dbus mar/ rje nyid dang*/ g.yas su sa skya bdag chen/ g.yon du 'bri khung chos rje kun rin pa bzhugs nas/ bdag chen pas sdom gsum gyi phyogs bzung*/ kho bos dgongs gcig phyogs bzung ste thal ba 'phang bas sa thams cad g.yos/ rje 'bri khung chos rje skyob par gyur/ bdag chen pa sa paṇa du gyur te gnyis kas karma par bsngags brjod mdzad pa rmis gsungs 'dug dge 'bri 'khrug longs skabs 'bri khung nas kong po'i dmag dgos tshul gyi zhu yig byung ba yang rje 'dis bshol/ 'on kyang 'bri khung pa rgyal tsam byung*/ 'or shod du 'khrugs chen langs par/ ra khyi phag sgar pa spyan 'dren la byung bar/ der phebs/ rgyal tshab pa yang phebs/ slob dpon chos mdzad la u rgyan bsnyen sgrub kyi khrid gnang*/ phrag yul du phebs tshe sbyin bdag grwa ris rnams dang zu ru gdong gi gzim khang sogs ngos 'dzin gnang*/ dga' ma mo gzigs pas dad pa tshad med mdzad/

dpal mkha' spyod dbang po zhal gzigs bstod pa mdzad/ dga' ma mor gdan sa pas spyan ma drangs pas rten 'byung 'ga' re yal/ de ma ja thog tu gdan sa ba byung nas tsan dan dkar po'i thub sku sogs phul/ dge sbyong 'brug dar rgyas kyis mjal/ phrag zeng po sum mkhar yan gyi yon bdag rnams tshogs par ching mdzad/ mtsho khra mo'i bla mas mjal/ thub sku lo brgyad tshad tsam la rab gnas zhus pas drung khro ba ltar mdzad gzan lcag rgyas nas phyag nas gnang bas snum tsar gyis song*/ de kar chos sde lnga zhes pa'i khrid yig dang*/ zab mo gtun khung ma/ rtogs ldan 'khrul sel sogs thugs brtsam gnang*/ rje rin po che la byams pas sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byon pa lta bu yong gsung 'dug cing nga la yang de 'dra gsung byung zhes gsungs/ yang lung pa 'di rin spungs 'dra zhes dang*/ byams chen sku skye la byad dbyibs 'di 'dra 'dug ces dang*/ de'i bar srid de rgyan chas bcas byung tshul sogs gsungs/ bla ma ba yo ba zhwa dmar pa btsal bar mngags pa dang*/ spang lebs gcig la sho rgyal bris nas sku rtsed gnang bas de slabs gyi rgyal pham thams cad lung bstan/ der sku'i bkod pa gnyis bstan/ gnas su phebs/ lam du rje dwags po/ dus mkhyen sogs bka' brgyud kyi bla ma thams cad gzigs/ bkra shis ljongs su phebs/ drung gong ma rnams kyi bzhugs khrir bzhugs/ gnas mjal mdzad/ der rgyud sde'i lha mang po zhal gzigs/ bde mchog phug tu zhabs 'dred shor bar phyag rjes byon/ ba yor phebs dus rgyal po mtshan ldan la/ bu gcig nged la phul gsungs/ bu chung zla ngo bco brgyad pa zhig yod pa dang*/ de yi tshul lugs rnams zhus pas de 'dir khyer shog gsungs/ de nas nyi ma re rer drung mkha' spyod dbang po da nam phebs kho na gsungs/ phrug gu de sku mdun du khrid byung bas/ ming la dkon mchog yan lag btags par mdzad/ dbu skra bzhes/

rnal 'byor dri med dpal de da lta byis pa'i tshul du phebs byung gsungs/ drung rol pa'i rdo rje'i sku gsung byon ma'i zhal nas/ 'di na rten 'di lta bu yod/ de nyid thon la lha sa'i spyan ras gzigs kyi mdun du bzhugs chug zhes pa'i gsung byon 'dug sog steng gi gtsug lag khang la rab gnas mdzad/ sprul skur na bza'/ phyag mdud/ dud rdzas sogs gnang ste gtsang sbra gyis zhes phebs/ ba yo mar 'phrang du rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zhal gzigs/ rab 'byams pa dpal 'bar sogs la phyag chen khrid gnang*/ mnga' ri rgyal mo'i sprul sku byon/ thugs rje chen po'i sgom bzlas sogs gnang*/ phag lo'i lo sar mdzad/ smon lam chen po btsugs rtsed sna mang po mdzad/ tshes gcig la nam mkha' dwangs shing me tog gi char babs pa sogs byung*/ de nas dga' ma mor phebs/ mkha' spyod dbang po dang chos dpal ye shes kyi sku gdung gnyis la phyag mchod sogs mdzad tsa gong gi gnas mjal/ mkha' 'gro phug tu phyag rjes byon/ zu ru gdong gi gzims khang gi las 'phro gnang*/ rang byung ba'i sbyin bdag glo mang pos mjal/ pags rigs sogs phul/ khyim gyi sgo gang na bstan sogs zhus pa ji bzhin gsungs pas de rnams shin tu dad par gyur/ thub chen mkhan chen pa sogs la zab mo nang don gsungs/ nub gcig mtshan phyed tsam na drung nyid rtog med du song ba na sku 'khor rnams kyis sku stems par go nas sku rim 'dra byas/ rtog med de las sad pa'i tshe dbu ma'i skor mang po gsungs/ da ni don 'di la/ rngog lo/ jo nang pa/ sa skya paṇa chen/ bu ston/ rong po rnams byon kyang mi 'jigs gsungs/ de nas bzung thal rang sngags rgyud/ lhag par gzhan stong dbu ma'i don thams cad thugs la shar/ thugs brtsam snga ma rnams dang mngon rgyan yang gzhan stong du bkral ba'i ṭīka mdzad/ de nas rgyal po mtshan ldan pha bu sgar du bos nas gzhan ngor ngos 'dzin sogs mdzad bcug

nam mkha' dri ma med pa'i mthong nyid du sogs kyi sprul sku'i tshul rnams phyag bris gnang*/ skabs der jo nang pa'i nges don rgya mtsho sogs dang*/ rma bya dang*/ shāka mchog gi dbu ma'i stong thun sogs gzigs/ nye gnas kyi mig skrongs pas rten 'brel gyi shog dril zhig btags pas mod la phan/ phyis mig gnyis ka zug pa na'ang rten 'brel gyi sngags gcig gnang bas myur du phan/ sngags de ga nas lags zhus pas/ pha dam pas gnang ba yin gsungs/ glo lam nag po nas phebs dus nags gseb nas kus 'debs pa na kong por phrin las skyong tshul gyi lung bstan du go /zhim bu nag po zhig gis lam bstan/ des brag la sbar brad byas par gter re yod cing*/ nag po spyod pa'i sku yang gter nas thon/ nyin gcig slob dpon zhi 'tsho/ ye shes snying po/ ka ma la shī la gsum dang*/ rngog lo chen po zhal gzigs/ mon rgyal po sprang dar btsun mo sras dang bcas pa byung*/ gser ljang rdung gi pad zhu sogs phul/ rgya gar ba'i rtse sna mang po phul/ bzhugs khri steng du 'jam dbyangs bzhugs pa gzigs bstod pa mdzad/ bzhugs gding la 'jam dbyangs kyi gdan zhes zhal yig rgyab ste rten sgom du yod/ zur ri gdong la 'jam dbyangs dgyes pa'i mdangs ldan btabs pa gnang*/ rmang lam du rje phrin las pas rnam bshad rig pa tshar gcig gsungs pa thugs la chags/ rje phrin las zhabs dang*/ dge 'dun sgang pa'i mkhan chen phebs par ja 'dren bcas rnam thos kyi ri bo'i yang dben du phebs/ rje nyid bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i mkhan slob kyi zhu ba phul te/ dgung lo nyer gcig pa'i mgo zla'i tshes brgyad nyin rnam thos kyi ri bor mkhan po rā hu la bha dra'i sprul pa brtan pa'i yan lag bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo bcu phrag lhag pa lon zhing*/ mkhas pa'i yan lag sde snod gsum la 'dzin mkhas gsal rig gi lnga tshan bzhi rdzogs pa dpal chos grub seng ge'i zhabs kyis mkhan po dang*/

karma pa'i phrin las pa chen po phyogs las rnam par rgyal bas las byed pa'i slob dpon/ mkhan po dpal shākya bzang pos gsang te ston pa/ grib tshod pa bla ma dpon yig pa bkra shis bzang po la sogs pa bdun gyi tshogs las bsnyen par rdzogs pa dge slong gi dngos po yang dag par nod cing sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mtha' dag la de bzhin gshegs pa nyid dang tha mi dad par gyur/ mtshan chos grub grags pa dpal bzang por gsol/ de'i tshe mkhan po las tshe dpag med grub rgyal lha mang gi tshe dbang zhus/ rnam sras mdung dmar can chos skyong du phul zhing khong gi bzhed pa gzhan stong gi bshad pa mdzad nas lta ba 'di khyed kyis 'dzin dgos zhes zhus nas/ phyis su mkhan chen gyi dgongs bzhed skong bar shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i don gzung 'dzin gnyis stong gi ye shes bden grub sogs gzhan stong du bkral zhing*/ mtshan yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dgongs 'grel rje btsun mchog tu ngal gso ba yongs 'du sa brtol gyi ljon pa zhes bya ba btags pa'i ṭīka chen brtsams te mkhan po la phul/ 'di la ma legs pa yod pas dpyad pa dgos gsungs nas se ra rje btsun gyis kar lan zhes bya ba zhig brtsam pa yod/ de yang dgung lo nyer gcig gi mgo nas nyer gsum gyi bar gyi ring la rje phrin las pa'i zhabs las mngon rtogs rgyan gyi 'grel pa don gsal/ byams chos bzhi tshad ma kun btus/ rnam 'grel/ rnam nges/ rigs thig gyes pa'i bstan bcos bzhi/ mngon pa gong 'og 'dul ba mdo rtsa/ rtsa she/ 'jug pa/ brtag gnyis/ rtsis kun bsdus pa sogs mdo sngags kyi gzhung chen rnams dang*/ bod yul gyi rngog lo dang phywa gtsang gi yig cha/ sa paṇa gyi sdom rig la sogs mdor na gzhung chen nyer lnga'i tshig don thams cad gsan zhing bde blag tu khong du chud par mdzad/ de dag gi bar rnams su dbang rjes gnang man ngag mtha' yas par gsan par mdzad/

de ltar gsan pa'i yun lo ngo gsum tsam de srid gsol ja'ang cung zad las mi bzhes par nyin mtshan med par tshig don bsam pa dka' gnas la dogs dpyod brgal brtags sogs kyis chos so so'i gting dpog par mdzad/ slob dpon rin po ches kyang 'di lta bu'i thugs kyi brtson pa dang*/ mkhyen pa zhes bsngags par mdzad/ mdor na thams cad mkhyen pa zhes mtshan 'bod pa tsam min par don gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po 'gran zla med pa ste/ mkhas pa dag drung du 'ongs pa na yang zil gyis non te dri lan zhu mi nus shing zhus pa rnams la'ang phyis 'gyod pa'i gnas su 'gro ba yin no/ /mnal lam du slob dpon rgyal rnga bdun pa zhes pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta zhig la tshad ma le'u bdun pa zer ba zhig gsan pa rmis/ gzhung de thugs la'ang chags 'dug pa rab 'byams pa phyogs glang gis yi ger bkod cing*/ rjes su byang pa chos mdzad pas phul ba'i dpe mang khrod nas ka ma la shī la'i tshad chen de yin 'dug spyir dgung lo bcu pa yan chad nas bzung byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa dang thugs mnyam gzhag gi sgo nas thos bsam gtso bor mdzad cing dgung lo nyer gsum phan chad ni thun mtshams ma gtogs mnyam gzhag gi ngo bo mi skyong ba thun tshod gcig nam yang byed ma myong gsung zhing des na rtogs pa mngon du gyur cing skye bo'i mthun snang du kong po bu chu sogs su 'gro don mdzad/ de'i tshe mkha' 'gro ma gser gyi gdu bu mang pos brgyan pas rma bya'i gdugs bzung ba/ ḍā ki ma gser gyi dril phreng 'khrol ba gnyis kyis zhabs nas bteg pa'i dpal sha ba ri pa rus pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pas bdag la rtogs pa drir byung gsungs te de'i lan ni/

sa dang po'i rtogs pa gang yin na// snang stong zung 'jug chos kyi sku// bden med sprin dang na bun bzhin// sa lnga pa'i rtogs pa gang yin na// gsal stong zung 'jug chos kyi sku// gnyis med rnam dag 'od gsal ba// sa brgyad pa'i rtogs pa gang yin na// bde stong zung 'jug chos kyi sku// spros bral 'gyur med mkha' rdo rje// sa bcu pa'i rtogs pa gang yin na// rig stong dbyer med chos kyi sku// sgrib gnyis rang grol e ma ho// zhes byas pas/ rang gis rang la ltos dang gzhan na med do/ /da lta gyi shes pa 'di ye shes yin gcig las med do/ /gcig de sems can yang yin sangs rgyas kyang yin/ da lta'i shes pa'i rang gdangs 'dir/ /ngal ba chen po ma byed cig /'di las gzhan du med do// zhes gsungs so// der byi'u shin tu mdzes pa zhig byung ba la/ mdzes sdug gi bye'u smra mkhas ma/ /zhes sogs gsungs pas gus pas nyan zhing mchi ma phyung nas song*/ drung na ne tso smra shes thugs brtse ba zhig yod pa'i skye ba zhus pas sngon sangs rgyas me tog bla ma'i bstan pa'i lhag mar rgyal po'i btsun mor gyur pa'i tshe dgra bcom pa pad+ma'i ze ba bsod snyoms la byon pa na bran mo legs 'dzin mas skur ba btab pa la de chos gsungs pas dad/ phyis ngan 'gro du ma brgyud nas ne tso 'di yin par tshigs su bcad de gsungs/ de nas lkog phreng gzim khang du phebs/ gnas bzang bas thugs spro zhing mgur du ma gsungs/ khyad par 'di khyed tshos yid la zung la gdangs shes par slob gsungs gnang ba/ sems zhi zhing gnas pa spros dang bral// gsal dngas kyi shes pa bde bar shar// rtog dpyod rlung gi dbyung rngub chad// bzang legs legs 'dra ba zhig de na mchi// khyed sgom chen yod na chags kyis dogs// rnam rtog phra ba tur tur po// dran pas zin pas bde bar shar// gnyis 'dzin shes pa'i rtsi bgrang mkhan// bzang legs legs 'dra ba zhig de na mchi//

khyed sgom chen yod na dred kyis dogs// blos byas stong pa cang med po// phar ltas stong pa yin no lo// tshur ltas sems nyid rig rig po// gcig tu 'dzin pa'i rbad khams can// bzang legs legs 'dra ba zhig de na mchi// khyod sgom chen yod na dred kyis dogs// 'di ka tha mal shes pa la// yod med mtha' bral rdul ma gos// spyod lam rnam bzhir khyer kyang btub// bzang legs legs 'dra ba zhig de na mchi// khyod sgom chen yod na 'chal gyis dogs// zhes sogs mang du gsungs/ slar lkog phreng gzim khang du sku mtshams kyi khongs nas chos rje mkhan chen pa la zab chos du ma gnang*/ gter bum gyi ri la phebs pa na zhabs rjes gsum tsam byung*/ rgyal 'dzin du phebs te nang so sogs kyis mjal/ dbang chos du ma gnang*/ klu'i rgyal po rgya mtsho'i pho brang du byon pas gzigs snang dang jo bo smṛ ti'i gdung 'bul bar gzigs/ de na rgya bod kyi grub chen thams cad bkod pa 'di lta dus logs bris su 'dug gsungs nas bod kyi 'gos 'brog mar 'brom sogs kyi ri mo'i bkod pa rgyab yig tshigs bcad dang bcas pa mdzad/ yang sham+bha lar byon pas shar sgo'i drung na 'dzam gling gi mi rigs sum brgya drug cu 'dus pa'i tshong 'dus la zhal blta ba'i thang sku 'di lta bu 'dug gsungs nas thub pa gangs can mtsho'i thang sku rgyab yig gi tshigs bcad dang bcas pa mdzad/ der gzigs snang gi rim pa mtha' yas pa las nyin gcig gi gzigs snang bris gsungs nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad la rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum bzhugs pa/ dkyil 'khor kyi mtha' sprin dkar gyis g.yogs pa/ de'i mdun du bkra shis rtags brgyad/ 'phan rol mo dbu rgyan dar dpyangs me tog phreng ba seṅge'i khri bdud rtsi'i bum pa ka pā la sna tshogs rdo rjes kha bcad pa nor bu rnga yab sil snyan phye ma phur ma sogs dang*/

de'i g.yas su phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sprul sku'i thig le kha dog sna tshogs pa'i nang du bzhugs pa zhes sogs dang*/ de'i 'og tu dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa dang zlum po sgo brgyad pa dang chos 'byung bsnol ma dang chos 'byung rkyang bas gang ba de'i mthar 'od dmar pos bskor ba'o/ /de'i 'og tu thig le'i nang du mgo bos gang ba dang mig gis gang ba dang lag pas gang ba sogs thig le'i nang na 'char ba'o/ /de'i 'og tu rtags bcu dang mun pa dang nam mkha' dwangs pa'i mthar sprin yod pa dang*/ nyi ma zla ba'i 'od ri la phog pa dang*/ thog ser dang char zim bu 'bab pa dang*/ skyes pa dang bud med mang po 'gro ba zhes sogs dang*/ bde mchog dkar po yab rkyang gi zhal nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'byung ba zhes sogs rnam pa sna tshogs pa ste/ 'di'i thang sku gcig kyang mdzad/ slob dpon klu sgrub/ nag po pa/ slob dpon dpa' bo rnams las chos so sor gsan pa zhang rin po che gzigs shing de'i sku'i bkod pa khyung du mdzad nas klu 'dul ba dang*/ dbang phyug gi sras mo mdzad de dbang phyug la chos ston pa dang*/ chos gsung pa dang mya ngan las 'da' ba ston pa dang*/ 'khor los sgyur rgyal gyi btsun mor mdzad de shi ba'i rkyen gyis rgyal po chos la sbyor ba dang*/ ri rab bshig pa dang*/ sgra gcan la bsnyen gnas 'bogs pa sogs lha ma yin 'dul ba zhes sogs gsungs pas slob dpon klu sgrub kyi rim lnga sogs dang nyid kyi rlung sems gnyis med las mnyam gzhag snang mched thob gsum gyi 'od gsal ba las rjes thob kyi ye shes shes bya thams cad dus gsum du sgrib med 'char ba ni sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rdo rje 'chang gi sku 'grub par gsungs pas 'di skabs mngon du gyur par snang*/ gzhan yang*/ kho bo sa steng 'di na byung ba'i tshe// rgya nag kha che yu gur li dang ni// za hor gser gling rnams na ngo mtshar ba'i//

cho 'phrul du mas skye dgu dad par byas// khyad par mi dbang rgya nag rgyal po yi// bsod nams spel slad zang zing dngos po'i tshogs// bdag la mchod phyir rgya nag mi dpon ni// brgya phrag mang po mchod cing bsti stang byas// 'on kyang rgya nag yul du 'gro dgos zhes// nan skyed chen po byas kyang kho bo yis// ga cing dpyad tshe sa bdag rgyal po ni// tshe yi 'phen pa gtong ba blos rigs nas// phyogs der 'gro ba'i brtson pa bshol gyur pas// mi dbang pho nya rab khros rang gnas song*// de la chos skyong tshogs rnams bka' phab ste// rgyal po'i pho brang me dang chu yi char// du mas nyam thag byas shing mi rung ba'i// ltas ngan du mas shar phyogs 'dzam gling pa'i// skye bo kun la grags pa'i bya ba byas// khyad par 'jang nag dpung tshogs zhi bar byas// hor gyi yul du tshig ma'i char pa phab// sog po'i rgyal po rāṣ+tū pā la yi// mdze nad phrin gyis bsal bas drin lan phul// yu gur yul du dug sbrul chen po la// yi ge bskur bas rgya mtsho'i nang du bros// kha che'i yul nyer dge 'dun 'bum sde yis// mkhan por dgos zhes de la 'di skad spring*// skye ba phyi mar bsgrub par dam bcas so// zhes pa la sogs pa'i rnam thar gsungs shing 'di re re'i lo rgyus rgyas pa'ang snang*/ sku'i sprul pa rgya nag dang sham bha la dang kha che dang u rgyan la sogs par yod tshul dang*/ mi tra dzo gi de sngon 'dan yul du mjal dus lo nyi shu tsam tshod du 'dug /phyis li thang du mjal dus dgung lo drug cu tsam pa sku rid cing sngo ba dbu skra dkar ba zhig 'dug /lha sa nas 'ongs gsung zhing bod kyi dgon gnas rnams na chos lugs bzang ngan 'di 'dra 'dug gsung zhing ston/ kho bo sau raṣ+tashi rgyal po'i mchod gnas byas/ da ma dha ra'i ri la stod du 'gro/ da dung lus 'phags 'di la lo stong tsam sdod/ de nas 'tshang rgya ba yin gsungs zhing gdams ngag dang dam rdzas du ma gnang*/

sku lus shel ltar mi sgrib pa dang*/ bya rgod la bsad gso dang*/ sdigs mdzub kyis gangs ri g.yo nus pa'i rdzu 'phrul bstan te khyed bod kyi grub thob sla bar 'dug gsungs/ rnam thos kyi ri bor phebs dus tho rangs thugs rje chen pos lung bstan par/ shar phyogs kyi sangs rgyas rab tu byed pa'i 'od 'khor dang bcas pas gnas 'di byin gyis rlobs pa dang*/ phyag na rdo rjes bar chad srung bar gzigs shing*/ don ldan mi yi dge sbyong 'di// don du bsgrubs na mi rabs gsum// chos kyi 'byung gnas dag tu 'gyur// sgrub po'ang lo gsum tshe ring 'gyur// zhes pa gsan te/ 'di don gsung pa ni mi 'dug kyang rje kun mkhyen chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi lung bstan yin 'dug /yang u rgyan bsnyen sgrub yin zer ba'i glegs bam mang po snang ba la gzigs pas/ gser gyi brgyad stong pa 'ba' zhig snang ba'i yig 'bru las/ shes rab zab mo rgyal ba'i yum// brjod par mi nus gsang sngags lam// rgas pa gso dang 'chi ba 'joms// rims nad sel byed rgyal ba'i yum// zhes gsan pa dang*/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal zhal gzigs nas rtsa rlung sogs gnad bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i do ha'i phyag chen sgom rim gsan pa dang*/ 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po lus mi mngon pa las chos gsan pa dang*/ sangs rgyas 'od srung gis dus kyi pad+ma 'byung gnas yin zer dge slong rgan po gcig gis skye ba dang rga shi med par 'dod na ma rig pa drungs nas 'byin par byos shig ces gsan zhing khyed da lta gang du bzhugs/ 'od srung gi dus gyi pad+ma 'byung gnas lags na yul gang du pad+ma las 'khrungs zhus pas/ nam mkha' 'di da lta gang na gnas/ 'od srung gi dus kyi nam mkha' de gang las byung zer te mi snang bar gyur/ 'o na sangs rgyas stong re re la pad 'byung yang stong 'byung bar 'dug snyam pa na de de bzhin zhes pa'i sgra grags so/

/zhes sogs grub rtags kyi mtshan ma mtha' yas/ de skabs tsam gyi rtags snang rnams mdor byas pa/ grub rtags dang po bde ldan ma dang mjal// gnyis par 'jam dpal la sogs byang chub sems// drug las man ngag gnang la sgro 'dogs chod// gsum par da lta'i gnas tshul tshe ring yang*// don mi 'gyur zhes nam mkha'i snying po nas// rgyal sras brgyad kyis legs par rjes su gdams// bzhi pa srog thur rengs par gyur pa dang*// lnga pa lus gnas pad+ma'i rigs rnams kyis// rgyal ba mnyes pa'i shes rab mig yul snang*// drug pa lce la ngag sgrib dag pa'i rtags// bdun pa pad 'byung la sogs mtshan ma ni// bcu yi sngon las bzlog tu mi btub kyi// de min tshe sgrub 'di dag 'bad byas pas// nag po'i phyogs kyi rkyen las grol zhes thos// zhes gsungs so// sgar pa 'gas bya spyod rtsing pas/ rtse lha sgang du phebs 'phral nas bya bral gyi spyod pa mdzad cing*/ dpon slob shāka rin pa dang drung nyid nas rig gzhung rgya mtsho la mtha' dpyod mdzad/ mngon rtogs rgyan ṭīka brtsams pa'i dbu tshugs par mdzad/ de nas zho kha bla ma dang*/ nags phu bla mas zhu ba phul nas stag lo'i lo sar steng sgar sngar bzhin bsgribs/ lo mjug dus rim mgon 'chams sogs dang smon lam rtse sna sogs sngar bas rgyas tsam mdzad/ 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char bab/ yar rgyab dpon chen pas mu tig gi mchod rten sogs phul nas rab tu byung*/ sbyor drug sogs kyi khrid mdzad/ snga mo nas a mdo bu yang zur mang sku skyer ngos 'dzin gnang ste zur mang du brdzongs par mdzad/ dge slong rnams la gzhi gsum gyi phyag len btsugs/ karma lo tsār grags pa smin drug chos mdzad rin chen bkra shis las sgra kā tsan dang snyan ngag 'chi med mdzod/ sum rtags dang yig rigs rnams gsan/ mdzod nag gi rten rnams la gzigs rtog gnang*/ bya btang thar pa'i sku skye sogs la bka' chos gnang*/

yang ri'i 'dus sde btsugs/ zu ru gdong du lo mjug dus rim dang*/ yos lo'i smon lam phrag thang du gnang*/ kong phyogs thams cad la chos rgya dkar po mdzad/ 'dul ba'i bslab bya/ lam sgron/ spyod 'jug /mdo sde rgyan sogs kyi ljags bshad gnang*/ drung nyid po to ba dang*/ rig ral sogs su gyur tshul dang rgya hor gyi rgyal po rnams smin grol la bkod tshul gyi sngon tshul rnams gsungs/ dbyar gnas grub nas ljongs rgyu'i nyin mi ma yin gyis phyag 'bul byed pa kun gyis mthong*/ rgyal ba'i dbang po dgung lo nyer drug gi thog nyi ma dang zla ba lta bu'i thugs sras gnyis 'byung bar lhag pa'i lhas lung bstan pa'i zla ba lta bu lho brag dpa' bo sprul pa'i sku phebs/ thog mar zhal 'dzoms mdzad nyin nam mkha' 'ja' 'od kyis khengs/ me tog gi char bab/ drung nas nā ro chos drug gi khrid dang*/ rab 'byams pa phyogs glang sogs la rdo rje gsum gyi bsnyen sgrub kyi khrid mdzad/ 'dul ṭīka gi mchod brjod brtsams tshe rmang lam du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten thams cad 'od kyis khyab pa zhig rmis/ mngon pa'i ṭīka chen brtsams pa'i dbu tshugs/ mdo smad shar nas dom tsha dbon po'i bsngo zhus 'bul ba/ las zhwa gser gyi rigs lngas brgyan pa/ las gos nor bu stong ldan sogs phul/ mtshal khung du bzhugs/ karma gra tshang nas dge bshes bcu tsam bos nas mtshan nyid kyi bshad grwa tshugs/ rtog ge 'khrul 'joms la zhu dag gnang*/ rje dpa' bo dang*/ sde bdun rab 'byams pa dang*/ phyogs glang sogs la/ bu ston rgyud sde spyi rnam gyi bshad pa dang*/ tshogs par rgyud sde lnga'i dbang*/ dge tshul slong phyed dang nyis brgyar tshogs pas dbyar khas blangs/ phrag mi rnams kyis dmag bsdus te kong lung ral gsum gyi dge dgon kun brlags par yon mchod gzhan thams cad gros 'chams pa la drung nas dge ldan pa'i khang chung zhig la gnod pa byed pa dang mgul pa bregs pa khyad med kyi bka' bab pas bzlog par mdzad/

'bri khung pa kun dga' rin chen pa'i sku gdung la rtse lha sgang nas phyag nas gnang ba 'bri khung du phebs/ gsa' phur tshogs par bcu gcig zhal gyi rjes gnang mdzad/ sgar du bsnyung gnas kyi srol btsugs/ rdza yig du rdol zhabs rjes byon/ rje dpa' bo sgar gyi bshad grwa'i zur chos la bskos/ rta lo'i smon lam mdzad/ drung pa sprul sku khams nas phebs/ zhal 'dzom mdzad par rje nyid dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor du gzigs 'dug / dge slong kun bzang gis drung gi zhal mjal ba'i mod la/ nam mkha'i mthong thams cad karma pas gang ba mjal/ spo bor phebs/ kar dge'i 'khrug pa bsdum nas srid gcig tu mdzad/ rtse lha sgang du lug lo'i smon lam mdzad/ dbon klu skyabs 'das/ sku spur la ring bsrel mang po dang mi g.yo ba'i sku sogs byon/ mdzod nag tu byes chas rten gsum sogs mdzod du rgyas btab/ dpur steng grwa tshang gis mjal/ phyag nas gnang ba re dgon du phebs/ bu chung mjal/ rtse lha sgang du khang pa la phyag nas zang thal du song*/ mgul cham gyis gsung 'gags par rab 'byams pa phyogs glang gis zhus te/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i rdo rje'i gsungs sogs gnang ste gsol ba btab pas 'phral du dngas/ drung pa si tu sku skyer bskos 'ja' dang las zhwa las gos gnang*/ gdan sa bar par bskos/ kong po 'bum ram pa bkra shis dpal bzang gis yum rgyas pa rgyugs phul/ spre lo'i lo sar mdzad/ brag gsum mtsho skor dang*/ nags phur phebs/ khrus khang du rgyal tshab sprul sku kham stod nas phebs/

de ltar myang kha ral gsum gyi lha sde mi sde rnams kyi re ba bskangs te 'bri khung du phebs/ paṇa chen rdor rgyal ba gral 'phros la 'dug par sde pa bco brgyad kyi lta ba so so dang*/ rang rig gi skor sogs dri ba gnang bas lan gsal po phul ma shes/ gral grol pa na spyir nged rang gzhung lugs rnams la byang ba'i khul dang*/ khyad par khar seng nas lta rtog mang du byas pa yin mod/ de rnams nas dri ba mi gnang 'dug pas mngon shes kyis dgong par 'dug ces gleng 'dug go/ /chos rje khri thog pas mjal/ mtshe'u khar/ 'bri khung rin po che pa dang*/ zhwa dmar pa/ paṇa chen rdor rgyal ba sogs la bde mchog bcu gsum ma dang*/ ras chung snyan rgyud kyi khrid gnang*/ thel pa spyi chos la lam rim dang*/ dgongs gcig gi zab bshad gnang ba rje dpa' bos zin bris gnang*/ bya 'jam dbyangs chos rjes phyag dpe dkon rigs pusti nyis brgya tsam bskur/ bdag gi yon tan gang shes 'di tsho la bltas pas byung ba yin zhus snang*/ dri ba'i shog dril zhig 'dug par lan zhib par gnang*/ dbus gtsang gi ja 'dren pa rnams 'byor/ klung shod bkra shis thang la gzhi byes lhan du phebs/ bla ma ku lung pa sogs lho byang stod smad kyi bla ma mang po dang*/ tshogs pa la'ang gang 'tshams gyi chos 'khor bskor/ legs bshad gling pa phebs/ rten gan+dho la'i mjal kha gnang*/ 'bri khung rin po che dang*/ zhwa dmar sprul sku sogs la phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid dang*/ zhang gi bka' 'bum lung dang dbang 'ga' re gnang*/ than pa byung bar sku khrus mdzad pa'i mod la char babs/ yangs can nas zhwa dmar gcig shos nas ja 'dren byung kha ba chen po babs/ der sangs rgyas mnyan pa'i dngul sku la rab gnas mdzad pas/ dus mkhyen/ karma pak+shi/ phag gru/ skyob pa sogs bka' brgyud bla ma rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ bde mchog yab yum sogs dang*/ ma mgon sogs bka' srung rnams dang*/

rje sangs rgyas mnyan pa zhal gzigs/ gsang ba bla med kyi rten 'brel lung bstan mdzad/ rug pa lha khang dang bka' gdams kyi dgon ka ma gzigs pas sngon tshul mang po dran gsungs/ stag lung nas ja 'dren dang*/ hor thar 'bum dang*/ khro rgyal 'bum sogs hor mang pos mjal/ stag lung du phebs/ gzim skyil du thang pa'i sku sogs gnas mjal mdzad/ 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char babs/ dge ldan rtse shar rje bsod grags pa/ rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho rnams kyis zhu yig gus 'dud spyan 'dren dang mjal 'dun zhu ba sogs byung*/ ra sgreng du phebs/ jo bo'i thugs dam 'jam pa'i rdo rje dang*/ jo bo'i dngul gdung sogs mjal/ smon lam mang po mdzad/ rten rnams la mchod 'bul dang tshogs par mang 'gyed gnang*/ 'ja' tshon dang me tog gi char bab/ sha ra ba'i phyag dpe rnams ko thum lcags gzer gyis bsdam 'dug par bden stobs brjod pas sgam rnams kha rang byer gyur pas gzigs rtog gnang nas rgyas btab/ ra sgreng gi gzhi bdag rnams kyis mjal sdom pa nod/ rmang lam du thang lhas mjal/ thang lha'i gangs mgul nas 'ja' kha dog lnga pa shar/ bye lung du 'brom dang mkha' spyod pa'i 'khrungs sa rnams mjal/ de nas rims par yangs can du phebs/ la khar dam can gyis bsu ma byas/ bya lo mgo zla'i nya la 'og min mtshur phur phebs/ nang so dang tre chung sogs kyis bsnyen bkur zhus/ spyi chos rgyud bla btsan lugs kyi bshad pa dang so sor nyams khrid gnang*/ zhwa dmar pa sogs la dus mkhyen bka' 'bum gyi lung mdzad/ karma phrin las par zhabs brtan 'bul pa bskur/ khyi lo'i lo sar dang smon lam rgyas par mdzad/ sde pa smyug la pas spyan drangs/ phebs lam du karma pak+shis lha chen bzhengs dus kyi ston mo'i thud dang mar gyi tshad kyi brag gzigs su phul/ ko khyim du jo bo sngags kyi bdag po zhal gzigs/ smyug lar phebs/ theg chen rtser rje phrin las pa mjal/

snying phrog dmar mo/ ku ru kul+le/ 'dod rgyal/ dur khrod bdag po/ sgrol dkar sogs kyi rjes gnang zhus/ sne gdong pa'i ja 'dren byung*/ yar lung sbus ri sogs kyi mjal mi rnams la spyan ras gzigs kyi sgom bzlas gnang*/ legs bshad gling gi bka' ram rnams dang*/ sgar grwa tshang gi blo gsal rnams gzhung chen rnams la bshad pa btang bcug /dbus gtsang gi dus 'khrug la bar chings kyi bka' shog gnang*/ smyug la bas 'bul chen bstabs/ sde pa blon 'khor bcas chos dang zang zing gis tshims par mdzad/ rje phrin las zhabs kyis dge ba thams cad byang chen du bsngo ba'i tshigs bcad/ nga yi bsam rgyu mtshungs med chos kyi rje sogs ljags brtsam mdzad/ de nas gnam gzhung du phebs/ phag gru'i sku phyag nas ma phul byung ba'i mdun du nas 'bru smug khra shin tu snum pa bre do lhag spungs 'dug pa thang lhas phul pa yin 'dug /de nas chibs rags pheb lam nas rim gro pa sangs rgyas dpal grub kyis gzim dung rnyed pa yangs can du kha gtad nas 'bud bcug /skung gi ri khrod du dgun bzhugs mdzad/ der yang dgon ri chos dang*/ chos drug /rlung sems gnyis med sbyor drug /ras chung snyan rgyud/ o rgyan bsnyen sgrub/ lhan cig skyes sbyor/ ro snyoms sgang dril/ blo sbyong don bdun ma rnams gnang*/ phag lo'i smon lam mdzad/ de nas gtsang du chibs kha bsgyur/ bo dong 'chi med sprul skus mjal/ bo dong pa'i grub mtha'i gsung 'phros du ma mdzad/ mkhas mthong legs po gnang*/ gra ma gru bzhir phebs/ sku 'dra rin po che mjal/ g.yag sde ze dmar du phebs/ ngur smrig gi sgrol mar snyan shal sogs phul/ rin spungs ngag dbang rnam rgyal sras blon bcas rin chen rgyan sprod kyi chibs bsu bcas rin spungs su phebs/ mkha' ru klu sding du gser mdog can 'bum ram pa sogs gral 'phros la 'dug sde pa dpon blon rnams nyin ltar du sku mdun du phebs/

dga' ldan pho brang du rgyal ba rgod tshang pa'i dbu thod mjal/ byams chen la snyan shal dang smon lam mdzad/ sgar gyi bshad grar shes phyin ṭīk chen ljags bshad gnang*/ drung gong ma'i bu chen sku lung bla ma sogs dang sgrub grar rang gi 'dod chos du ma stsal/ sde pa zil gnon pa bsnyen par rdzogs/ karma 'bangs zhes btags/ rmang lam du shāka mchog dang mjal/ bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrub pas lung pa dri bzang gis khyab/ de nas shangs mthong smon du phebs/ gser mdog can nas chos rje lcang ra bas mjal/ dbu tshad kyi dri mol zhib par gnang song yang mkhas mthong tsam mdzad 'dug /jo nang pa rat+na bha dra byung*/ dbu tshad skor gyi dri mol mang po mdzad/ mkhas mthong legs po gnang*/ rje btsun kun dga' grol mchog phebs pas mjal/ 'di pa dang dpon slob kyi rten 'brel 'grigs na lhag pa'i lhas lung bstan pa'i nyi ma lta bu'i slob ma de yin na'ang*/ tshig sna cung zad ma 'phrod pas legs lam du ma gyur pa ni bdag bar khams pa mi rgyu rtsub pas brdzad ces gsungs pa yod/ shangs chos 'khor nas dus 'khor rab 'byams pa bos nas gsan du re ba gnang ba la/ dbang rgyud bshad man ngag dang bcas pa mtha' rgyas su phar gnang nas dad pa thob par gyur/ nyug rgyal khang du dgun bzhugs mdzad/ bla ma bam spom pa 'ba' ra gdan sa pa sogs la chos 'brel gnang*/ byi lo'i smon lam mdzad/ 'jang gi 'bul skyel ba sleb/ sde pa dpon blon la tshe dbang sogs mdzad/ thob rgyal kun spang pa bsnyen par rdzogs/ mi ring bar gzhung lugs shin tu mkhas par gyur te/ 'di pas phyis thob rgyal 'dul grwa gling btab bshad grwa btsugs/ gser mdog can du phebs/ bya rgod phung po'i chos khrir bzhugs/ dpal mchog pas 'dul ba'i bshad pa phul/ bsam 'grub rtser phebs/ brgya tshor sgar phab/ rtser spyan drangs gsol ston zhus/ 'bum ram pa dge 'dun nyi ma dang*/ chos rje rngo bstan la 'bel gtam mdzad/

skabs 'dir la stod lho khri skor nang zhig pa'i mgon skyabs mdzad/ zhal ngo mi gti la bzhugs dgos pa'ang sgar du chos mdzad byas nas bzhugs chog pa mdzad/ sprul sku sman thang ba sogs la dbu ma'i lta khrid dang spyi chos su sne zur ba'i lam rim sogs gnang*/ bkra shis lhun po dang*/ zha lu ri phug /ngor chu mig khro phu snar thang rnams su gnas mjal mdzad/ rten gan+dho la bshams/ sde par mjal ka gnang*/ bya gshang chos rje/ chos rje nub ra ba/ chos rje gnam pa sogs la 'dod chos gang dgos gnang*/ phung po ri po cher spa nam sde pa la spyan ras gzigs kyi rjes gnang sogs stsal/ khu lung mi la'i sgrub phug mjal/ yar 'brog mngon dga' nas 'chi med pa phebs/ ram lding ma dang*/ 'brong bu dgon rnying*/ jo mo gangs rnams su phebs/ dkar leb du sgrub pa ba rnams la rnam thar legs spyad ma'i 'grel pa gnang*/ gsol 'debs btsugs/ don du thang lha sogs gzhi bdag rnams la chos bshad pa yin 'dug /der zhabs rjes kyang byon/ de nas spel ram gzim khang gsar btab du bzhugs/ mchil phu'i ri khrod du grub thob gling ras zhal gzigs te mgur mang po gsungs/ de'i nye 'dabs su dpon mo gser khang mas mjal/ bud med la phyag rjen phyag dbang mi yong bas sna log byas song*/ o rgyan ri khrod dang 'bram dgon sar du phebs/ spyi chos su dgongs gcig gi 'grel pa dang*/ sger chos kyang 'ga' re gsungs/ mtshan mo gzim khang la mi ma yin gyis bskor ba byed pa'i sgra 'ur tir byung*/ yar 'brog khri dpon/ zang zang ne ring bla ma/ sgam po sku skye/ bya btang thar pa ba'i sku skye 'jang gra ba sogs la so so'i 'dod chos gnang*/ glang lo'i smon lam mdzad/ chos 'byung phug tu rdo rje theg pa'i thugs dam mngon du gyur tshul gyi mgur mdzad/ de nas yangs can phyag mdzod dang hor rnams kyis spyan drangs nas zhwa dmar mchog sprul yangs can gyi khrir bkod pa'i shis pa brjod/

de skabs dus zing langs pas chos rje 'dzam gling pa skyabs zhu bar sleb/ ma yum gshegs nas spur bzhu ba'i skabs/ 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char bab/ bdag mo yon mchod bros nas phun tshogs rtsis len la rim gro pa mngags/ yar 'brog sna dkar rtser spyan drangs/ khri dpon pas bsnyen bkur zhus/ der sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung dang*/ rgya hor kyi 'ja' sa rnams gzigs phul/ mngon dga' chos sde dang*/ stag lung pas 'bul zhabs phul/ pho ma lha khabs su rgod tshang pa'i sgrub phug tu yun ring bzhugs/ lho la yag pas gdan drangs/ gu ru lha khang du phebs skabs chibs pa zhig shi ba yungs 'bru lta bu'i ring bsrel gyi phung por gyur/ lha lung brgyud/ lho gro bo lung du phebs/ sras mkhar du bzhugs/ rje zhwa dmar pa sogs kyi bla sgrub mdzad/ nang thams cad 'od zer gyis gang ba dang mar pa yab sras rnams zhal gzigs/ dgun gang ba bzang po'i mgul kha tor bzhugs/ rgyal mkhar rtse'i zhal bdag dgos zhus par nged karma pa la rdzong gzhis dang mi sde'i bdag po byed pa'i srol med gsungs/ sil ma la brgal rkang tshugs khar sde pa srang mgo bas gzhi len zhus/ smyug la bas spyan drangs sbud sde phur bzhugs/ dbyar zhal gyis bzhes/ chos rje zhwa dmar sprul skur bsnyen rdzogs phul nas kong po la pheb pa'i pheb rdzongs dang*/ chibs skyel mdzad/ legs bshad gling par mang 'gyed dang*/ sde pa dpon blon la dbang khrid sogs gnang*/ de nas sham po'i mgul du bzhugs/ yos lo'i smon lam mdzad/ sos ka khrom sar bzhugs/ pho brang nas go shri dpon slob phebs/ 'bul chen dang 'jang rgyal po'i 'bul skyel sleb/ bsam sde dpon mos grwa tshang bzhugs gnas su klu sdings phul/ de nas dwags po sku rab pas spyan drangs nas lcags rtse dang gri gu brgyud sku rab tu phebs/ dwags la sgam por sku 'dra rin po che la na bza' sogs phul/ tshogs par mang 'gyed btang*/
