sku rab tu sde pa khri thog par bskos 'ja' gnang*/ dge slong don grub rin chen bla mar bskos te zur ri'i 'dus sde btsugs/ dwags kong gi dad 'dus rnams kyi re ba gang bar mdzad/ byang skyid phug tu phebs/ zhang g.yu brag pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i snang ba byung te mthar thug dbu ma'i 'jog 'tshams thal 'gyur 'thad pa'i lugs su bzhed nas/ 'jug pa'i ṭīka chen brtsams par mdzad cing thal 'gyur pa'i gzhung 'dzugs par gnang na'ang gtso bor ni rje rang byung zhabs kyi dgongs pa gzhan stong gtso bor mdzad pa'o/ /mdzod 'grel la zhus dag gnang*/ sbrul lo'i smon lam chen mo mdzad/ gnyal smad du mgon po'i zhal 'bag mjal snyan dar dang gtor gsos gnang*/ gser phye 'bum pa dang karma pak+shi'i sku 'dra mjal/ gser chab sogs gsol/ rtse mo ri'i skyed tshal du bzhugs/ khri dpon pa la dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa phog ste gnyal sde drug gi 'dus sde'i bla mar bskos/ sho bor dbyar gnas mdzad/ rje bkra shis 'od zer 'das pa'i dgongs rdzogs bsgrubs shing phyis sngags grwa yang btsugs/ mon dom tshang du phebs/ rje mtsho sna pa 'khrungs sa'i mchod rten mjal/ bya pa sprul sku'i bsnyen rdzogs gsan bzhed par drung skor rnams kyis bshol btab/ mon rgyal po sprang dar gyi bu mo sogs kyi 'bul ba rnams bzhes/ dus mkhyen sgrub gnas su phebs mgur gsungs/ yar 'brog gshag rtser dgun bzhugs dang rta lo'i smon lam chen mo mdzad/ sos ka dga' rir phebs/ rgyal tshab sprul sku zhi bar gshegs pa'i dgongs rdzogs mdzad/ yar lung bdag pos zul phu nas der phebs/ rngog chos rdor ba'i bzhugs gnas dang mar pa'i gdung khang mjal/ 'u shang rdo'i gnas mjal mdzad/ de tshe gnas chung rgyal pos rgyud bskul te 'bras spung bas dmag bsdus nas sgar pa bkag jo mjal la 'byon ma bcug pas mi ring par mtshal stag gi gtsug lag khang la me gnod byung ngo*/

/tre chung pa myur du shog gsungs pa la/ skabs der pheb ma grub pas bla ma gshegs/ sku 'khor rnams la rgyas 'grel dri med 'od kyi ljags bshad zla ba drug tu mdzad/ gangs ri thod dkar gyi gnas gzigs gnang*/ der rdo la zhabs rjes mang du byon/ zul phu'i dgon 'dabs su chibs pa'i rjes kyang byon/ khams dang 'jang gi 'bul skyel sleb/ lug lo'i smon lam chen mo mdzad/ rje nyid zhing khams gzhan du gshegs pa'i gsung byon pa na/ zhwa dmar dpa' bo sogs so so nas brtan bzhugs phul bas dgung lo brgyad du bzhugs par zhal gyis bzhes shing rje dpa' bo rin po cher tshur la zhabs brtan smon lam rgyas par gnang*/ bya 'dul gyi ljags bzhugs pa'i mchod rten la zhig gso dang rgya 'phan sogs phul/ tshes bcu gsum la gung thang gi gtsug lag khang me la shor/ gye re lha khang mjal/ chu shul dang*/ legs bshad gling du phebs/ rje phrin las pa'i sku gdung la mchod pa rgya cher phul/ chu bzang gi gong der dbyar gnas mdzad/ legs bshad gling pa dang bcas par dgongs gcig gi bshad pa gnang*/ rin spungs pas rgyal rtser dmag bshams par bka' shog gnang yang nyan ma 'dod/ gnam khog dang mtshur phur phebs nas/ zhig gso'i mkhar las tshugs/ nub gcig shog dung chen po mnam pas ltos gsungs/ de nub stag lung lha khang mes tshig pa dang*/ 'ba' 'brom lha khang zhig par gyur/ mgon po'i dgra chos mdzad/ sprel lo'i smon lam mdzad/ gser thog bsgrub cing*/ shangs lugs rgyud sde lnga'i dbang sogs dang bka' chos mang po stsal/ dge slong g.yung yang ri'i bla mar bskos/ mtshur phu'i zhig gso grub nas lha phu bas spyan drangs te gtsang du phebs/ gnam na mgor 'bri khung zur pa dang mjal/ zhal 'phros smar 'bul ba mtshon tsam 'dug par 'bul slog chen po gnang*/ zur pa shin tu dad par 'dug /zab phu lung du o rgyan sku mjal/ snyan dar sogs dang mchod 'bul mdzad/

drel sna gdong du yo khul dang*/ khro rgyal 'bum pha bu la lugs gnyis kyi bka' lung rgyas par gnang*/ karma si tu'i 'bul chen byung*/ bya lo'i smon lam chen mo mdzad/ thob rgyal dgra 'dul gling du phebs/ sku gsum ngo sprod kyi khrid brtsam grub/ zla 'dzin sgo yig la bsnyad pa'i lung bstan mdzad pa thams cad thog tu babs/ 'ba' brom lha khang zhig gso grub par phyag nas gnang ba 'ba' brom du phebs/ sku 'dra'i dbu thog tu phyag nas spungs pa lta bur gyur/ byang rigs rnams kyis phyag nas bzung rgyu byung*/ tre chung gi gser 'bum la phyag nas gnang ba'ang der babs/ sde pa lha phu bas dpal lho dgon dang sras gcig sogs phul/ der nye gnas sangs rgyas dpal grub bla mar bskos/ bra gor nas zhabs tog zhus/ rgyal tshab sku skyer dbang dang byin rlabs mdzad/

rgyal tshab sprul sku gong ma de dag sgar pas stod smad du gdan drangs pas sku tshe ma byung*/ da res lo bcu gnyis su khyed rang tshang gis zhabs phyi zhus gsungs/ gru bzhir sku 'dra rin po che mjal/ rab sgang phyogs kyi 'bul skyel ba rnams 'byor/ byang thang du gangs dkar nas sde pa srang mgo ba byon 'bul chen bstabs/ khyi lo'i smon lam mdzad/ lcags rtse gri gu brgyud/ lha khang du phebs/ spyi chos su 'dul ṭīka bshad pa gnang*/ dbyar gnas mdzad/ byang pa nang so sogs kyis nyin gcig la brgya 'bul bcu gsum tsam byung*/ rje zhwa dmar ba sgar du phebs/ sku gsung thugs rten sku chas grwa pa chibs sga 'khor sogs gnang*/ bzhugs khri 'dra mnyam mdzad/ sa gzhi thams cad dar gos gser dngul sku gsung thugs rten sogs kyis bkang nas phul/ nyin gcig phyag sgam thams cad kha phyes te ngo sprod zhus/ mdo khams nas mnyan pa sku skye dang si tu rin po che phebs/ bzhugs khri 'dra mnyam mdzad/ gsung rab gling gi grwa tshang btsugs/ g.ye chu tshan khar phebs/ de dus mi nga ni yar stod dpon mos bos sogs lung bstan mang po mdzad pa ji bzhin thog tu babs par gyur/ dge ldan pa'i dge bshes 'ga' byung ba dang rje rin po che'i bzhed pa rnams dri mol gnang bas kun dad pa thob/ chos grwa gzhung lugs gling du phebs/ dge 'dun rnams la spyan snga grags 'byung gi grub mtha' chen mo'i rnam bshad gnang*/ grwa tshang gi dge bshes du mas bshad pa phul/ rje dpa' bos sras mkhar gyi gser thog grub pa'i dga' ston 'bul ba byung*/ phag lo'i smon lam dang*/ gan+dho la'i rten bsham sogs gnang*/ zhwa dmar mchog sprul la sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i rjes gnang phul/ de skabs su yang ri ba mtshur phu dang*/ zur ri ba 'brong dgon sdod pa dang*/ rje nyid ri khrid mdzad pa dang*/ sgar pa rnams zhwa dmar par skyabs zhus na legs tshul sogs gsungs/

de nas lcags zam khar bzhugs/ gtsug lag khang gi rmang bting*/ 'jang gi 'bul skyel ba grwa pa rnams la sdom pa phog /rdul tshon las/ dus 'khor sogs kyi dkyil 'khor rnams bzhengs/ dus 'khor gyi gar dpon zhwa dmar pas mdzad/ gnyis par bde mchog gi gar/ gsum par rdor dbyings kyi gar rnams kyi sa 'dul mdzad/ yul pa rnams kyis rang rang gi bro bzhes sogs phul/ slar lo mjug de'i dgu gtor zor rgyags mdzad/ byi lo'i lo sar la sprul skur phag gru'i phyag zhabs kyi rjes yod pa'i sku thang phul/ sgrub mchod de rnams mu mthud/ zhwa dmar mchog sprul 'dus sde bcas pas rdul tshon chur gshegs/ de nyin 'ja' dang me tog gi char babs/ cho 'phrul dus mchod gan+dho la'i rten bsham sogs mdzad/ rten rnams zhwa dmar mchog sprul la deb bsdur bstsal nas khur phul/ skabs der gsung rab gling 'dzugs rgyu grwa tshang bsgrigs/ tsha ba rab 'byams pa karma phrin las chos 'chad par bskos/ sgar gyi rta pa khyi rdzi yan sku mdun du thong shig pa'i bka' gnang*/ sku rab par bshad sgrub gling gi rten de 'jim sku byas na bzhengs sla ba dang nged kyis phyag nas 'thor ba'i dgos pa yod gsungs/ sbo zlar gzim khang gi sgo nas pho rog zhig gis skad sna tshogs 'don pa na 'di nga 'bod mkhan red gtor ma byin gsungs/ de nas sku rab nas sgar btegs sgo pas sbrum gsang gling du spyan drangs/ spyi chos su chos rje gong ma rnams kyi rnam thar rnams dang rje bdun pa'i rnam thar rgyas pa dang*/ rje nyid kyi rnam thar gsungs/ sne'u gdong dpon pas dus 'khrugs zhi ba dang*/ mgon skyabs zhu ba'i gdan 'dren pa slebs/ drung nas lha 'dre rnams kyis kyang gdan 'dren byung bas phebs dgos gsungs/ zhwa dmar sgar gzhis dang bcas pa der bzhugs/ rje nyid phebs/ brag kha yang dgon du bzhugs/ dpon sa'i gdung rgyud skyor mo lung pa rnam rgyal rab brtan gtsos drung 'khor kun kas phyag 'bul mdzad/

sde dpon so sor bslab ston gyi rtsa tshig bkram pas yar lung sogs kyi dmag 'khrug thams cad zhi bar mdzad/ de nas ser sbreng gis bsus/ gdan sa thel du phebs/ de nyin drung nyid dbu zhwa bka' gdams kyi sne ring bzhes/ de la gnad ka zhig yod gsungs/ dang por sku 'dra rin po che mjal bas gzhan dag gis sku 'dra dang*/ gsung gleng gnang ba mjal/ gsol 'debs kyi mgur mdzad/ 'jag spyil kyi sku 'dra sogs mjal/ spyan sngas gtsos 'dus sder mang 'gyed gnang*/ mthil gyi khyad nor thams cad gzigs su phul/ yang dgon gyi phyag dpe rnams dang dbu thod sogs mjal/ yar klung sogs kyi dus 'khrugs rnams zhi bar mdzad/ jo bo'i gdan sa lha khang ke rur gdan drangs/ bsam yas su phebs/ de ma thag tu dkor bdag chen po bab nas gdan drangs/ skyabs sdom zhus/ byang chub chen por bstod pa mdzad/ bla bre snyan shal gser chab sogs phul/ mchims phur phebs nas slar khams gsum zangs khang du phebs/ bsam yas skor du zla ba gcig la bzhugs/ de nas yar rgyab pas spyan drangs nas byams pa gling du phebs/ paṇa chen bsod rgyal gyi gsung 'bum la gzigs/ zur mang dpon po sleb/ ja brgyad brgya sogs 'bul chen 'dug /glang lo'i lo sar mdzad/ gsang sngags rnying ma ba la skur pa btab pa'i rtsom byang drung gi mtshan g.yar ba de la brtsams tshul la dogs dpyod dang lan gyi yi ge zhig mdzad/ tshes bcu'i 'chams gzigs phul/ bco lnga'i nyin byams pa'i mdun du byams pa gling pas mdzad pa'i smon lam de 'debs par mdzad/ sgrub mchod kyi rdul tshon dkyil 'khor rnams gzigs/ 'jang gi 'bul ba bzang la ltos che ba grwa rgyun rnams sleb/ byams pa gling pa'i sku 'dra phyag tu bzhes ma thag ring bsrel gsum tsam byung*/ snye mdor spyan drangs/ byams gling mchod rten mjal/ byams gling pa'i gsung 'bum rnams gzigs/ spyi chos sger chos mang po gsungs/

rje zhwa dmar pa'i zhabs rjes mang po zhal bar byon/ rnam sras gling du phebs/ zhal ngo zhig grwa par phul/ de nas yar klung du phebs/ mthong rtser bzhugs/ dpon sar tshe dbang dang bka' chos gnang*/ shel brag tu phebs/ mgron gnyer dge 'dun rgyal mtshan 'das pa'i gdung la ring bsrel du ma byon pas sku 'khor rnams la'ang 'di 'dra zhes thams cad ha las/ yar klung dpon nas sa cha dang gzhis bcas phul kyang ma bzhes/ klu mes kyi gdan sa thang po cher phebs/ 'phyong rgyas su phebs/ srong btsan bang so'i klu sdings su bzhugs/ dge lugs pa'i dge bshes 'gar rje'i lta grub rnams bshad pas dad pa thob/ der char slong mdzad pas char chen babs/ bde skyid gling du phebs/ rje rang byung ba/ sangs rgyas mnyan pa/ rje nyid/ sgar gyi bkod pa 'dus sde dang bcas pa 'brir bcug /yar 'brog sga 'dra'i chu tshan khar phebs/ nged kyi rjes su gzhi bdag mang po 'gro 'dug gsungs nas bsangs dang gtor ma btang*/ byis pa lkug pa la gsang chab blud pas smra shes pa dang phyag nas zang thal du phebs pa sogs byung*/ de nas tsā rir phebs/ sku rab sde pa sku mched phyag 'bul la phebs/ bsam sde klu sdings su grwa pa mang por bsnyen rdzogs gnang*/ sgo bkra shis sgar du rje dpa' bo phebs nas zhal rgyas mdzad/ rim gro pa dge slong sangs rgyas dpal grub mjal bar shog gsungs pa grwar sleb/ 'du khang du grwa pa rnams la zhal bkod mang po gnang*/ tsā rir bzhugs ring*/ stong gsum shong ba'i glang chen spyi bo la zhes sogs rnam smin gyi lus dag pa dang*/ rnam smin gyi lus gtum mos bsregs te ye shes kyi lus su gyur pa dang*/ rdo rje phag mo phag gdong chen mo'i spyan dbus ma'i steng du dpal 'khor lo bde mchog bzhugs pa sogs dang*/ dpal ldan bla ma'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsis 'khor 'das thams cad lcags la gser 'gyur gyis thebs pa ltar gyur nas sangs rgyas kyi ye shes rdo rje'i lcags kyus kyang dbral ma nus pa dang*/

mtshan 'dzin thams cad rdo rje pha lam gyi me thabs gru gsum gyi rnam pa can gyis smin par byed pa sogs dang*/ gu ru mtshan brgyad/ zhang gi sku brgyad/ karma rab brgyad rnams dbyer med du sgrub pa bka' rgya ma'i zab chos skor dang*/ rje nyid lho phyogs kyi snying po dag par tshangs pa'i rgyal mtshan du sangs rgyas nas chos ston pa dang*/ bla ma he ru kar bzhengs te mchog tu mi 'gyur ba'i ye shes stsal ba sogs thun mong min pa mang po brnyes par snang la/ gzhan yang*/ sngon nā gārdzu na'i zhabs la gtugs sogs sngon gyi skyes rabs rnams gsungs pa dang*/ sman thang pas tho rangs tshe sgrub chag med byed pa mkhyen nas bka' stsal pa sogs dang sngar bshad pa'i rgya nag rgyal po cing de la zhal gzigs pa dang*/ gser yig pa tshang mas zhal gzigs pa sogs brjod las 'das so// de nas rmang lam dang bstun te mgur pa rnams la bka' bzhi seng chen ma'i mgur 'then bcug /sngon drung don ldan zhabs zhing brje khar yang ka bzhi seng chen ma'i mgur 'then gsungs pa yin sogs gsungs/ bod rdo mtshan khar tshogs 'khor mdzad/ rje rgod tshang pa'i zhabs rjes sar chibs bzhol nas byin rlabs zhus/ mtsho dkar du gzim khang ma grub par chos 'byung sbang dil du gzim gur mdzad/ mtsho skor 'khor nas gzim khang du bzhugs/ rim gro pas khang pa 'di cung che ba dang*/ mthor 'dug zhus pas/ mi lto bdag sku gshegs sa byed bsam pa yin pas mi mang 'du yong bas che dgos phebs/ khyung rdzong du rje zhwa dmar ba bzhugs/ tsā ri'i gnas phyi nang thams cad gzigs/ thugs brtsams dang dpe gzigs sngar bas smar bar mdzad/ nye gnas kyis zhus te/ rgod tshang ba'i dge sbyor bdun ma'i khrid gnang*/ stag lung sku mched gsum thugs nang cung zad ma gshim pa bde 'jags mdzad/ dbu ma brag dkar ba'i grwa pa 'gar spyan sngas mdzad pa'i lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid gnang*/

zla ba dgu par sku dpung g.yas pa cung zad bsnyun zhing sku 'khor rnams la/ da ni nga yang tshe'i rting pa yin/ dri mol 'dra byed rgyu yod na dri mol gyis shes phebs/ bdag 'das pa'i rjes su kham phrug zhig la karma par bdag rkyen byed yong zhes dang*/ da lta nga'i zhal la ltos/ spur thal yin zhes thal ba 'gom dgos pa yong gsungs/ stag lo'i lo sar mdzad/ rje zhwa dmar pa yang rkyen med par thugs mi bde ba dang rmang lam du tshems bud pa rmis gsungs/ sgra pa kun chos pa'i bsngo rten byung bar da ma legs bcom ldan 'das 'da' kar sngon la shā ri bu sogs 'das pa yin gsungs/ thugs brtsams rnams kyi mtha' grub par mdzad/ rdo rje 'jigs mdzad kyi skor brtsams grub pa na dga' ston du e ka dzā ṭir phebs/ tshogs 'khor mdzad/ zhabs la mi gtsang ba sna tshogs kyis 'byar byas pa dri bzang du 'thul/ bde ba can gyi zhing khams dang 'od dpag med kyis chos gsungs pa gzigs/ de skabs kong dmag dwags por slebs nas rje zhwa dmar rin po che dwags kong gi dum la 'byon dgos byung*/ rje dpa' bo sku mdun du spyan drangs/ sku 'khor ba rnams kyis zhus nas tsā ri nas btegs/ tsā ri gong lar phebs pa na/ mdo khams nas phur tsha dbon po sogs kyi 'bul chen slebs/ rin spungs sde pa rin chen dbang rgyal gshegs pa'i bsngo rten byung bar drung gi zhal nas khar seng mtsho dkar du sde pa byon byung ba gzhi bdag yin bsam tsa sde pa'i bar srid du 'dug gsungs/ nang mo zhig zhabs bde nas har bzhengs mdzad/ phar cam tshur cam mdzad/ bka' lung dang chab shog chung ngu la'ang gces spras mdzad/ 'di rnams karma pa mi bskyod rdo rje'i gsung gi tha ma yin gces par bya dgos gsungs/ zhwa dmar drung nas kyang zhabs pad brtan dgos pa'i zhu yig kho na 'dug /sku rab tu phebs/ phyag sgam rnams la dbye bsal mdzad/ 'di dang 'di ni karma pa'i spyi rdzas yin/

'di dang 'di ni bdag gi mchod sbyin rgyu yin sogs gsungs/ dngul rnams karma pa'i rus bu'i snod dang stong skud 'di rnams kyang gos sku'i rgyu byed dgos gsungs/ de skabs mjal mi 'gas pad zla la bzhugs pa rgyab 'od yod pa mjal/ pheb lam du mjal mi rnams ma bkag gsungs nas skya ser thams cad la mjal ka btang*/ shangs mtshal byung ba chu dang bsres nas khrom la gnang*/ bshad sgrub gling gi gtsug lag khang skor thams cad la gzigs/ dge 'dun la bka' lung mtha' dag gnang ba'i rjes su kho bo yang myur du pheb yong ba yin/ de bar chos dang mthun par mdzod ces gsungs/ yang zur bla ma rnams la chos shod/ khur khur zhes gsungs/ mjal mi bkag pa na thugs mi dgyes par mdzad/ byar yul stod smad kyi mtshams su jo bo be'u ra'i lha khang mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi rten/ jo bo li sku gcig bzhugs pa la byar stod smad gnyis kyis sman bla rdo sku zhig rnyed pa la jo bo'i khang par bzhugs su gsol/ der mjal mi mang bas de'i nye skor klu bdud gdug pa can yod pa la phog thug song bas der 'gro tshad shi ba dang*/ nad rims kyis lam bcad/ der rgan po rnams kyis rmi lam na'ang karma pa spyan drangs na drag zer kha mthun pas spyan 'dren zhus/ rje thams cad mkhyen pas mdzad pa tha ma yin dgongs nas phebs/ klu gnas sa'i snying khar karma lha khang brgyab/ rten thub pa gangs chen mtsho zhig bzhengs/ de'i thugs kar karma pak+shi'i li sku bzhugs/ klu bdud kyi yan lag bzhi la mchod rten nag po bzhi bzhengs/ nying lag bzhi la rang thag bzhis mnan/ klu nad lhag ma rje nyid kyis bzhes nas nad rims 'phro chad par mdzad/ ces sman bla rdo sku'i dkar chag yig rnying du snang*/ stag lo nas cung zad bsnyun tshul bstan/ sman pa bzhis gsol sman phul ba tshogs rdzogs ched zhag bdun re'i bar sman pa re re'i gsol sman bzhes par mdzad/ zla ba brgyad pa'i yar tshes nas sku bsnyun che ba'i rnam pa dang*/

zhabs bsnyun pas gsang sngags gling nas 'do li la spyan drangs/ 'do li la gsol ba btab tshad klu nad las grol zhes smon lam byed pas da lta mtsho dkar lha khang na yod/ 'do li 'degs pa rnams la phyag chen gyi khrid gnang*/ dbu la prog zhu dang rin po che'i phreng ba du mas brgyan te longs sku'i rnam pa mdzad/ mu tig gi dbu rgyan sogs bzhes te mjal ka btang*/ bsam sder phebs pa'i snga 'gros song mod/ ra mo sman chu'i brag rtsa der bzhugs pa yin gsungs/ mgon g.yag de yang der bsdad/ phyi nyin thugs khams dwangs zhing bka' lung du ma gnang*/ da nang grub thob bir+wa pa mjal byung gsungs/ sku skye ba phyi ma'i lung bstan/ nga skye ba 'di'i 'og rol du// shar tre shod gangs kyi ra ba'i bstod// dpal 'jig rten dbang phyug rang byon drung*// chu sgra bcas dam chos nyan pa yod// sa de dang ha cang mi ring bar// ngas skye ba lan pa'i mtshan ma mthong*// zhes dang*/ mtsho dkar gzim chung gi thog srub nas phyag ris rnyed pa ni/ gung tham thum rmi lam bag tsam na// ma ye shes ḍā ki yin no skad// sku mdog dkar mo 'od du 'bar// zhes sogs dang*/ khyod zhing khams gzhan du 'gro dgos gsungs// 'gro don gzhan du che'o skad// mi kho bos dmigs pa skad cig btang*//

shar tre shod gangs kyi ra ba ru// mi kho bo'i pha ma rnam gnyis mthong*// khyed dbyings na bzhugs pa'i srung ma'i tshogs// mi kho bo'i bstan pa'i gnyer kha mdzod// zhing khams gzhan der mi lo ni// gsum las sdod ri srung ma'i tshogs// zhes phyag ris su gnang ba las sku skye phyi ma'i lung bstan sogs sku 'khor rnams kyi sems las spang phyir dngos su ma gsungs 'dug /dgung lo bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad pa stag lo khrums zla'i nyer gsum gyi nyi ma gung du sprul sku'i dkyil 'khor bsdu ba'i tshul bstan to// de'i tshe char zhod chen po'i skabs yin yang gzim gur gyi thad nam mkha'i mthong bye nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gsal/ 'ja' 'od dang me tog gi char babs/ phyogs thams cad nas sgra chen po grags/ lung pa'i mda' der gnas tshang zhig na khams pa'i dpon zhig gis ja bskol/ ja tshom zhig byin da lta rang song phyi nas karma pa bzhugs mi yong zer/ de ma thag ja zhus dang me tog khur/ sku 'khor rnams la lo rgyus bshad/ ja dang me tog phul song*/ de nas sku gdung rin po che mtshur phur gdan drangs/ chos rje dpa' bos sku gdung zhugs su phul/ dgongs rdzogs mched 'bul rgya cher bsgrubs/ chos rje zhwa dmar pa rgyal tshab tu mnga' gsol/ gdung rus rnams dngul gdung chen po'i nang rten du bzhugs/ gser zangs las gzim mal sku 'dra yang bzhengs nas/ rje dpa' bo/ zhwa dmar mchog sprul/ mtshur phu gu shrī rnams lhan rgyas kyis rab tu gnas par mdzad do// bka' brtsams kyi skor la/ 'dul ba mdo rtsa'i 'grel pa/ mdzod ṭīk /'jug pa dang*/ mngon rtogs rgyan ṭīk 'bri khung dgongs gcig gi rgyas 'grel/ rlung sems gnyis med kyi khrid yig /mos gus chen mo'i khrid yig dang*/ sgyu ma chen mo'i rgyud 'grel sogs mdo sngags kyi gzhung chen du ma dang*/ ka lā pa'i zha lu'i bshad sbyar dang*/ sdeb sbyor ṭīka'i mchan 'grel/

cha tshad kyi bstan bcos nyi ma'i me long sogs rig gnas kyi skor sogs gsung 'bum pusti nyi shu'i skor dang*/ chos sde gsar 'dzugs kyi gral la/ ljang rgyal pos btsugs pa'i khang sar mgo / 'dob spang phug /ru yon chos sde sogs bod chen ljongs kyi phyogs rnams su chos sde gsar 'dzugs mdzad pa rnams dang*/ rtsa lha sgang dang*/ phrag sgrub sde/ chu bo ri'i sgrub sde/ yang zur gnyis/ zur ri gdong gi chos sde/ yar stod du karma gzhung lugs gling*/ dwags po bshad sgrub gling*/ sgrags sngags gra sogs bshad sgrub kyi sde bzang la grangs mang ba du ma btab/ sku gsung thugs rten gsar du bzhengs pa rnying pa gso ba sogs ni bgrang las 'das so// ༈¿¿rje de'i bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa 'dzin pa'i slob ma rnams ni/ zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa dkon mchog yan lag /rje dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba/ rgyal tshab grags pa dpal 'byor/ tā'i si tu chos kyi go cha/ ngo khro rab 'byams pa bshes gnyen rnam rgyal/ rab 'byams pa rnam rgyal grags pa/ shes rab rnam rgyal/ phyogs glang legs pa/ ngo khro chos mdzad/ kun dga' bkra shis/ byang sems nyi ma bkra shis/ rab 'byams pa sangs rgyas ye shes dang bsod nams bzang po dang*/ byang chub bshes gnyen rnams dang karma phrin las legs grub/ thob rgyal kun spangs pa karma don dam yang dag 'phags/ rim gro pa sangs rgyas dpal grub/ dbon rab 'byams pa rin chen legs pa/ dpal khang chos mdzad karma phrin las sbas pa/ zur mkhar blo gros rgyal po/ snyan ngag smra ba a gnyan dbon po/ lha mthong lo tsā bshes gnyen rnam rgyal rnams dang*/ rtogs ldan gyi slob ma rnams ni/ yang ri bla ma rtogs ldan kun tu bzang po/ zur ri bla ma don grub rin chen/ g.yung rtogs ldan rin chen mgon po/ chu bo ri'i bla ma sangs rgyas seṅge dang*/ shar pa ye shes dpal bzang*/ bya bral rgyal mtshan bzang po/ bya btang thar pa'i sku skye/

dbu ma dbon chung*/ bla ma mtha' phu pa/ rab 'byams dpal 'bar/ ljang pa chos mdzad/ 'ja' mo dge slong*/ bla ma karma bstan 'dzin sogs dang*/ byin rlabs zhugs shing zhabs tog bsgrub pa'i slob ma rnams ni/ 'tsho byed shang dkar ba phan bde 'od zer/ sku rab lha btsun don dam 'phags dang*/ mdo rgyud rgya mtsho sku mched/ sprul sku ba nam mkha' bkra shis/ karma srid bral/ byang sems kun dga' rin chen sogs dang*/ 'bri khung gdan rim bco lnga pa rin po che rin chen rnam rgyal/ gdan sa thil spyan snga sogs mi chen gyi slob ma dad ldan rnams sogs so// ༈¿¿sprul pa'i sku rgyal ba gtsug lag phreng ba ni/ sku bltams pa'i gnas dbu ru snye thang gi sgang rgyud bya bar gnyags dz+nyā na ku mā ra yi gdung rigs yab bla ma dar dang*/ yum lam rnyed sgrol ma'i sras su shing pho byi ba lo dpyid tha sa ga'i tshes bcu gsum gyi nyin yum la gnod pa med par spyan hrig ge gzigs bzhin par 'khrungs/ ring po ma lon par gsung byon pa'i thog mar yang*/ sems can rnam pa sna tshogs la// byis pas 'gro don nus par shog/ ces gsungs shing sa skyong don yod rdo rjes nga'i bla ma'i sku skye zhes dad gus 'gyur med kyi sgo nas dgung lo lnga ma bzhes bar du yum sras sogs dpon slob lnga'i rgyun gyi zhabs tog zhus shing bdag rkyen phul du phyin par mdzad/ dgung lo lnga bzhes pa chu 'brug gi lo la dge bsnyen cha lung bas/ da lta rnal 'byor rol pa ye shes 'od// kho bo nyi zer 'di la spyan 'dren 'dod// zhes sogs bskul ma mdzad de/ nā ro mai tris lung bstan pa'i bka' brgyud yongs kyi chu mgo rje mar pa'i gdan sa chen po dpal bro bo lung zhes bya ba'i seng ge'i khri chen por phebs te/ lho phyogs kyi grwa ris dang sbyin bdag rnams kyis gus 'dud chen pos mchod pa dang khyad par gnas brtan shākya rgyal mtshan dang mkhas grub sangs blo bas zhabs tog gi gtso bor mdzad/

du sogs kyi dag snang dang thig le'i dbus su lha sku dang gzugs brnyan mang po gzigs/ rang sems gdod ma'i sangs rgyas dang sogs mgur mang po mdzad/ bla ma rtogs ldan dge 'dun rgya mtshos sku'i rim gro pa dang gsan sbyong 'bul ba'i slob dpon mdzad de bris klog sogs mthar phyin pa'i tshul bstan/ de nas sa skyong don yod rdo rjes dbu lo bsil ba dang rab byung mdzad par bskul te/ dgung lo dgu pa spre'u lo shar ba dang*/ rje zhwa dmar bzhi pa dpal chos kyi grags pa'i drung du byon te snga ma dge bsnyen dang bar ma rab byung sngon du 'gro bas dge tshul du sgrub par mdzad de/ mtshan dpal mi pham chos kyi rgyal po don thams cad yongs su grub pa zhes bya bar gnang*/ mkhan po'i drung nas phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor sogs dam pa'i chos dang zang zing gi gnang sbyin rgya chen po mdzad/ lo de'i rgyal zla'i dkar tshes lnga la thub chen gzim khang du rje karma phrin las pa dang thog mar mjal te dgung lo dgu nas nyer brgyad kyi bar du gtso cher rje de nyid bla mar bsten nas dam pa'i chos mtha' yas pa gsan no// dgung lo bcu gcig pa la smyug la paṇa chen ngag dbang grags pa dang mjal te mnyes pas rjes su bzung zhing bka' gdams glegs bam dang lha bzhi'i rjes gnang sogs zab chos mang po dang*/ phyag drug mgon po chos skyong du gnang ste zla ba gsum gyi bar du nyin mtshan chos kyis 'da' bar mdzad do/ /dgung lo bcu gnyis pa la yer pa lha ri snying po'i mgul du shar dwags po'i paṇ+ḍi ta chos rgyal bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dang mjal te 'dul ba lung dang dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang dang rdo rje phreng ba dang*/ sgrub thabs rgya mtsho sogs dbang rjes gnang du ma dang phyag chen chos drug dang rtsis kyi dka' gnad sogs zab pa'i gnad mtha' yas pa gsan/ de nas yer par bzhugs skabs zhogs rtsi dmar du dbus smyon he ru ka chen po dang mjal ste zhal snga nas sngon kho bo slob ma'i 'os yin na yang de bla ma'i 'os yin pas gdams ngag thams cad sbyin no zhes phyag chen ma rig mun sel la nyams khrid mdzad/

gzhan yang shog dril bzhi pa 'ba' ra chos drug sogs dam pa'i chos kyi zab gnad kyi khrid bka' brgya dang nyi shu lhag pa gnang*/ thugs dam gtor ma dbu thog tu bzhag ste bka' bsgo gsol gdab mdzad nas kho bo nas brgyud pa'i dbang thams cad rdzogs pa yin no zhes dang*/ gzhan yang rten 'brel mang du bsgrigs te ston pa'i sku zhig gnang nas bstan pa'i bdag po dang phrin las mnyam pa/ tshe dpag med dang sku tshe mnyam pa/ mi la ras pa dang sgom sran mnyam pa/ stong kun rgyal po dang longs spyod mnyam pa sogs rten 'brel mang du bsgrigs/ sprul sku kun bzang 'dzam gling nyi zla ltar grags pa zhes pa'i mtshan gsol te mnyes pa mtha' dag gi sgo nas rjes su bzung ngo*// dgung lo bcu gsum pa la sems dpa' chen po blo gros dbang phyug zla ba drug gi bar du bsten te rdor phreng gi dbang rdul tshon la brten nas yongs rdzogs dang/ gzhan yang dam pa'i chos du ma gsan no/ /dgung lo bcu bzhi pa la mkhas grub bud+dha ma ti la rje dpa' bo nas brgyud pa'i chos drug sras mkhar ma dang*/ oḍ+yan bsnyen sgrub sogs zab chos mtha' yas gsan no// dgung lo bcu drug pa la smra ba'i dbang po 'chi med dpal bzang mjal ste/ sbas snying spyi gsum sogs bo dong thams cad mkhyen pa'i chos bka' mang po dang sgra snyan ngag sogs dpyis phyin par gsan/ gzhan yang rje btsun snyan grags bzang po las/ phag mo don grub ma dang*/ ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po las phyag chen dang*/ karma pa bdun pa'i thugs sras bya 'jam dbyangs bkra shis rnam rgyal sogs la'ang dam pa'i chos kyi 'brel pa gsan/ dgung lo bcu bdun pa la mkhas grub kyi 'dun sa legs bshad gling du byon te bsdus pa nas bzung rje phrin las pa'i drung du+u bka' chen bzhi sogs mdo sngags kyi gzhung chen rnams 'dzin chos dang bgro gleng dang bshad pas gtan la phab ste/ dpyis phyin par mkhyen pa mdzad pa dang*/

mkhyen rab rnam rgyal las sum rtags dang sa ris sogs gsan/ gzhan yang sbyong dkyil dang do ha sems 'grel skor gsum sogs dbang dang gdams pa mtha' yas pa gsan no// dgung lo nyer gsum bzhes tshe mkhan po don gyi slad du mtshan nas smos te/ zhwa lu lo chen chos skyong dpal bzang po dang*/ las slob gnas brtan dgra gcan zin gyi rnam 'phrul mkhan chen chos grub seṅge dang gsang ston sde snod 'dzin pa nam mkha' dpal ldan sogs dad pa'i dge slong bdun gyi tshogs las bsnyen par rdzogs pa mdzad/ de nas gro bo lung du phebs te o ḍ+yan bde chen rtse zhes pa'i gzim khang du lo gsum bar du sku mtshams 'dag sbyar mdzad de/ lo nyer bzhi pa la aṣ+ta'i bsnyen chen mdzad/ shig nad sogs lhongs kyi rnam pa ci yang byung ba rnams ro snyoms kyis lam du gtong ba gnang zhing*/ nye gnas la 'jam dkar gyi rjes gnang mdzad dus a yig dkar po'i char babs/ phrin las pa dang jo bo rje dang thams cad mkhyen pa rang byung dang rong ston shes bya kun rig sogs rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma mang po dang*/ yi dam chos skyong sogs dpag tu med pa gzigs shing mjal/ smyug lar sgrol dkar dang*/ gnya' gnya' ru ri brag thams cad sgrol ma dang*/ spyan ras gzigs/ tshe dpag rta mgrin rnams su gzigs/ der dad btsun mang po 'dus/ gro lung gi mkhar las gnang*/ de nas dgon du bla ma zhig zhu nas dgon sde rnams de la gtad de rgya gar du pheb pa thugs thag bcad/ rong pos lha mo shra ma ṇa'i sgrub thabs gnang*/ trag shad kyi rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gi me rnams mchod rten gyi rnam par 'bar/ dgung lo nyer dgu la shar phyogs kong yul gyi zings po 'bum pa sgang du rgyal ba 'jig rten dbang phyug karma pa thams cad mkhyen pa mi bskyod rdo rje dang mjal/ dad gus mi bzod pa 'bar te gsol 'debs mang po rang shar du byung*/ dgon gnas 'khor dang longs spyod thams cad phyag tu phul nas a wa dhū ti pa'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pas zhabs phyir bzhugs/

rang gzhan don gnyis grub bo dbyangs can ma/ /zhes pa'i mgur ma la bshad pa mdzad pa chos 'brel gyi thog ma yin/ rje'i zhal nas/ khyod nyid sleb nas kho bo'i bdud rtsi ga pur du gyur pas rten 'brel yang 'grigs pas rnal 'byor ma'i sgo nas bdud rtsi ril bu sgrubs shig gsungs te/ dpon slob lngas bsgrub pa na rtags khyad par can mang du byung*/ bdud rtsi ga pur du gyur pa ni zur mang pa'i rten khrod du bzhugs pa bdag gis kyang mjal/ byang sdom lugs gnyis ka stsal/ dpal gtsug lag phreng ba zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ gtsug lag ni sde snod dang rig gnas thams cad kyi spyi ming yin pas/ bi hā ra bsgyur ba'i gtsug lag khang gi don ni/ min pas bi ha ra mā lā bri ba rnams ni ches rmongs pa'i las so/ /tshe 'di la ltos pa spu tsam med pa dang*/ byang chub kyi sems bdag gzhan brje nus pa'i thugs dam 'khrungs shing*/ rje yi bka' ltar phag mo'i bdud rtsi ril bu bsgrubs pas lce thog tu bzhag pa tsam gyis tha mal gyi rtog pa 'gags nus pa byung bas/ bdud rtsi ril bu'i sgo nas mnyes pa thob par mdzad/ ber nag can gyis khyod kyi slob ma bsu ba la 'gro zer nas song bas tam shul tsam la sleb tshod yin zhes gsung 'dug/ mdor na zhal mjal ba nas nye bar bzung ste/ rje'i chos drug chen mo dang*/ o ḍ+yan bsnyen sgrub dril bu rim lnga lhan cig skyes sbyor sogs bka' rgyud sde bzhi'i dbang rdzogs mang po dang*/ khyad par dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang rdzogs par gnang nas rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa thams cad gtod par mdzad/ chos drug chen mo/ ras chung snyan brgyud/ phag mo'i bskyed rdzogs/ bka' chen bzhi sogs dang*/ brtag gnyis sogs kyi bshad pa gnang ba rnams la zin bris mdzad/ gzhan yang rig gter dang*/ nang don sogs kyi ljags bshad gnang*/ sdong po gru sor rje pak+shi zhal gzigs shing*/

rje karma pa nyid sangs rgyas kun 'dus su gzigs te mgur mdzad/ dgung lo so bdun la nye ba nas bzung tsā ri'i gnas nang rong chung zhes par zla ba lnga/ gzhu gru bzhi'i mkha' 'gro gsang phug tu zla ba phyed dang gnyis/ mkha' ro'i gsang phug tu zla ba gnyis/ rig 'dzin pad+ma'i gnas mtsho dkar gyi khyung rdzong du lo gsum rnams bzhugs/ mchog gi dngos grub brnyes par mdzad/ rje zhwa dmar lnga par rdor phreng sogs kyi dbang mdzad/ rgyal tshab grags pa dpal 'byor bcas dpon slob gnyis ka la gzhan yang dbang rjes gnang sogs zab chos mtha' yas pa phul/ gung thang du skye med zhang gis byin gyis brlabs/ sku mkhar rin po che la rgya phubs dang*/ gser thog sogs sgron/ rje tshul khrims dbang phyug spyan drangs nas rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur gyi lung tshang bar gsan par mdzad/ rgyal ba'i dbang por zhabs brtan phul yang ma bzhes par/ rje 'di rdo rje'i stan la bzhugs su bcug nas zhabs brtan gnang*/ rje thams cad mkhyen pa mi bskyod zhabs kyi bka' phebs ltar dpal karma rig 'dzin sgrub mchog sde bzhi'i dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs/ lha sa'i jo bo bcu gcig zhal 'dra ba rtsa zhal ma gtogs cher mi gsal ba zhig la sems bskyed phul ba'i snang ba dang*/ bde ba can du phebs pas karma pa nyid sngon nas phebs zin 'dug pas o rgyan chen po'i cha lugs su bzhugs pa dang*/ phyogs thams cad tshe dpag med kyi skus khengs pa la mi 'dod bzhin du 'gong song ba byung*/

de nas rje thams cad mkhyen pa mtsho dkar nas sku bsnyun bab shin tu lci ba'i tshul dang bcas te yar stod ra mor dgung lo zhe brgyad pa la dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim pa'i sku gdung rin po che zhugs la 'bul ba'ang rgyal ba 'di nyid kyis mdzad/ sngar nas gsol ba btab pa bzhin zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin pa lnga pa rgyal tshab tu seng ge'i khri chen por spyan drangs te/ rgyal ba 'di nyid kyis shis pa brjod cing mnga' gsol/ sangs rgyas mi 'gyur lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang phyi nang rten brten pa dang bcas pa mthar phyin par bzhengs/phag mo rtse dang bsam yas su phebs skabs bsnyun bab lci bas thugs rig sku lus las gzhan du don song yang slar sku tshe'i 'du byed byin gyis brlab par mdzad/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog yan lag dang rgyal tshab sprul sku grags pa don grub gnyis mdo khams su mchog gi sprul sku dbang phyug rdo rje spyan 'dren la phebs nas/ rje yab sras rnams khams phyogs nas ma phebs kyi bar du zhwa dmar nag gi rgyal tshab kyi khur bzhes te dbus gtsang dwags kong sogs su phebs/ spyir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mtha' dag dang*/ sgos su karma pa'i bstan pa la 'dzin skyong spel gsum 'gran zla med par bskyangs/ sras mkhar gtsang khang du ston pa sangs rgyas rab bdun/ kun dga' bo dang phyag rdor khro bo gnyis/ mar pa'i sku dang bka' brgyud gser phreng sogs bzhengs/ sras mkhar ru ba la jag pa rgyab par thun gtor 'phen par mdzad pas de rnams la bka' chad chen po byung*/ de nas dgung lo drug cu'i skabs zhig sku shed chung ba tsam ma gtogs bsnyun gzhi gzhan med kyang da ni kho bo'i bya ba de tsam yin gsungs te/ phyag g.yog nang ma rnams la zhal chems kyi shog dril zhig gnang ba'i tshe rgyal ba yab sras ma phebs bar du zhabs pad brtan par gsol ba btab pas/ 'o na re zhig sbos la zhog gsungs ba dang khams su rje yab sras rnams kyis brtan bzhugs mdzad pa dang dus mtshungs par snang zhing*/

rje zhwa dmar bas thugs rtsol bskyed pa'i rje brgyad pa'i sprul sku spyan drangs te stag lo zla ba gsum pa'i tshes bzhi'i nyin lha mi'i 'byor ba lta bu'i mchod sprin gyis bsu+u ba'i bkod pa mtha' yas pa dang bcas te rgyal ba yab sras rnams gdan sa chen por zhabs kyi pad+mo bkod pa'i de ma thag tu yab sras gsum ka lhan cig tu+u rgyal ba nyid kyi gzim chung du phebs nas zhal mjal gdan 'dzom ste nyin re bzhin dam pa'i chos kyi bgro ba rgya cher mdzad/ rje karma pa dang rgyal tshab sprul pa'i sku dpon slob gnyis la sgrol dkar gyi tshe dbang sogs chos mtha' yas pa'ang phul/ rje zhwa dmar pas mkhan po dang rgyal ba nyid kyis las slob mdzad de dad pa'i dge 'dun bcu'i dbus su mchog gi sprul sku dbang phyug rdo rje dang*/ rgyal tshab sprul sku grags pa don grub gnyis dge tshul sgrub par mdzad/ rgyal ba'i dbang por dpal ldan mi pham chos kyi dbang phyug tu mtshan gsol/ rje karma pa'i drung du zang zing gi dngos po mtha' dag dang*/ sras gro bo lung gis gtsos pa'i gdan sa ma lus pa phul/ rje'i drung nas rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yin pas bslab sbyang la ma ltos kyang bslab sbyangs kyi tshul bstan pas gsan bsam sgom pa thams cad ji lta ba mdzad nas bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu zhes pa'i zhu ba gnang*/ rgyal ba'i dbang por phyag chen chos drug /o rgyan bsnyen sgrub/ sbyor drug /phag mo'i bskyed rdzogs/ yi ge bzhi pa ro snyom lnga ldan sogs dang*/ gzhan yang byang sdom lugs gnyis/ phag mo'i dbang sogs phul/ mgon po phyag drug pa sogs zhal gzigs pas bstod pa re yang mdzad/ mchog dman gyi gdul bya mtha' yas pa smin grol la'ang 'god par mdzad/ de nas gdul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams chos la bskul ba'i phyir/ mi rtag pa dngos su ston pa dang gzugs sku chos dbyings su+u bsdu ba'i phyir mya ngan las 'da' ba'i mdzad pa ston par bzhed de sku la bsnyun mi mnga' zhing ting nge 'dzin 'ba' zhig tu bzhugs pa las skabs 'gar da lta mchod pa shoms bya ba yang yang gsungs/

sku 'khor ba rnams la dad pa'i rten sna re gnang nas/ zhal snga nas da ni kho bo yun ring mi sdod 'gro bar nges pas kho bo'i rjes 'jug rnams kyis tshe 'di'i bya ba la snying po med pas de'i dbang du ma btang bar dam pa'i chos bshad pa rnams nyams su longs gsungs pa'i bka' phebs pa na/ sku 'khris pa rnams kyis bstan pa dang sems can rnams la dgongs nas sprul pa'i sku myur du phebs pa dang*/ sa cha dang yab yum sogs bka' stsal gnang dgos zhus pa na mtshur phu'i nye skor zhig tu yong gsungs/ slar nan gyis zhus pa na de 'dra u tshugs byed mi dgos khyed rang tsho la dka' las mi yong ste yab sras kyis gzigs yong gsungs pa'i bka' phebs tsam las ma byung ba phyis rje dkon mchog yan lag gi gsung las chos rje rin po che'i sku skye ban dher byon pa de rtsod med nges 'drongs rang yin gsung byung ba des na dpon slob mjal dus snyan du phul grub par snang*/ de nas dgung lo re gsum pa zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bcu drug gi tho rangs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan no/ /de'i tshe mar me rnams kyang 'od cher song ba dang*/ spos kyi dri ngad dang rol mo sna tshogs pa'i sgra dbyangs dang dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis mchod pa'i sprin phung dang bcas te bde ba can du spyan drangs par yang mngon no/ /dgongs rdzogs su rgyal tshab sprul pa'i sku phebs te mchod bsngo mdzad/ sku gdung rin po che zhugs la phul zhing gdung rus thal rnams dngul las grub pa'i byang chub chen po'i mchod rten nang du bzhugs so// nus pa'i yon tan kyang 'bri khung du rab gnas mdzad dus bgegs phug ron gyi gzugs su don pa dang*/ dwags por lha chen rab gnas skabs bgegs sdig pa'i gzugs su don pa dang*/ thun gtor 'phang ba'i lam srin mo chu kha'i brag chad pa dang*/ dwags po rnam grol dgon du seng yab dib pa phaṭa sgras de gar sdod pa dang*/

g.yag la zhal ba bskal ba 'dril blta stang gis bzung ba dang*/ bka' bcu pa dad pa khams na 'dag sbyar la yod pa la zhal bstan pa dang*/ bud med zhig gis g.yu chen yul khams ri ba phul nas mi snang bar gyur ba dang*/ gzhan rgyud dang lkog gyur mkhyen pa ni smos kyis mi langs shing*/ bstan bcos kyang phag mo'i rnam bshad chen mo/ chos 'byung chen mo dang*/ rang byung ba'i rtsis kun bsdus pa'i 'grel pa rin chen gter mdzod/ rje brgyad pa'i bzhed pa skyong ba'i spyod 'jug gi rgyas 'grel sogs mang po bzhugs so// ༈¿¿rgyal ba 'di nyid kyi zhal slob kyi gtso bo rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dbang phyug rdo rje/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog yan lag /rgyal tshab sprul sku na rim gnyis rnams la bka' brgyud rin po che'i zab chos dbang lung mtha' yas pa bum pa gang byo'i tshul du 'bul ba mdzad/ gzhan yang 'bri stag dang grub chen pak+shi'i gdung rigs sogs gdung rigs kyis che ba du ma dang*/ tre che chung sogs sku skye bar zhal gyis bzhes pa mang po dang*/ rgyal ba ny-id dang rnam dbyer med pa'i 'jam dbyangs don grub dpal bzang po dang mkhan chen legs pa don grub dpal bzang po dang grub chen dngos grub bzang po sogs bstan pa la bya ba rgya cher mdzad pa du ma dang*/ yar 'brog khri dpon g.yu lo ba/ sku rab sa skyong bsod nams rab brtan/ lho stod sa skyong gsang bdag rdo rje sogs zhabs tog shin tu che ba'i stobs kyi sa skyong ba du ma dang*/ mdor na rgyal ba 'di nyid dang 'du 'bral med cing snang srid phyag rgya chen po'i dkyil 'khor du shar ba'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug mtha' yas pa dang*/ ston sgom chen po dang*/ rtogs ldan dang rnal 'byor pho mo'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig byon pa yin no// ༈¿¿si tu bkra shis dpal 'byor gyi sku skye dpal mi 'khrugs chos kyi 'od zer ram chos kyi go cha ni/

zur mang rtsi rgyud du 'khrungs/ rje mi bskyod zhabs kyis gtsos pa'i mkhas grub kyi bla ma bdun sogs bsten/ mdo rgyud man ngag gi bdag por gyur te rdo rje 'dzin par mnga' gsol/ lung las ka dang bcas gdan sar bskos/ g.yen mo che'i nyams gsos dang*/ 'thus btsun sum brgya tsam bsdus/ dngul ljang rdung gi ston pa'i sku mi tshad dang*/ rje brgyad pa'i gser sku sogs dang/ gzim sku dang*/ dngul gdung rnams bzhengs/ spungs ri nang so spyan drangs te gdung brgyud kyi chad pa bsabs/ rje dgu pa tre shod du sku 'khrungs pa ngos 'dzin mdzad pa la phebs/ zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa sprul pa'i sku+u spyan 'dren la phebs par gzhi len zhabs phyi rgyas par zhus/ sku tshai'i smad du spungs ri nang so gdan sar bskos nas nyid ri khrod mdzad pa'o/ /'di pa'i skabs su+u karma'i dge ru phal cher zhig gsar du byung ba yin cing*/ 'be po ru'i mchod gzhis rnams kyang 'di dus phyag tu bzhes pa'o// ༈¿¿go shrī grags pa dpal 'byor ni/ lho rgyud seṅge sgang zhes bya ba'i yul du yab sngags 'chang bzang po dang*/ yum dkon mchog bzang mo gnyis kyi sras su me pho byi lor sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo bdun par grub chen sri dkar ba dang mjal tshe dbang zhus/ spu 'bor du phebs tshe rdo rje g.yu sgron ma mched bcu+u gcig dang bcas pas rang rtags srog snying dang dam bca'i glu phul/ spungs rir chos skyong gi sku rang byon gsar du ston par mdzad/ phyag sor gyi rjes byon/ rje kun dga' bzang po la rdo rje phreng ba dang sbyong rgyud dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis dang*/ phyag chen dang*/ chos drug sogs gsan/ gtor bsngos skabs/zhing skyong gtso 'khor bzhi po gzigs/ bsnyun pa'i tshe dam can gyis bsnyun g.yog zhus/ dgung lo bcu gcig par rnam thos kyi ri bor rje mi bskyod rdo rje thog mar mjal zhing dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa stsal zhing grags pa dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i snying po zla med mngon par mtho ba zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/

rgyal ba rgya mtsho dang rdo rje ber can la sogs pa'i dbang dang*/ sku gsum ngo sprod kyi khrid gnang*/ dpal karma pas mkhan po dang*/ gtsug lag phreng bas slob dpon mdzad de bar ma rab byung dang dge tshul gnang*/ rje dpa' bo'i drung nas snga phyir 'dul ba/ phar phyin/ tshad ma rnams kyi bshad pa dang*/ zhang gi bka' 'bum/ skyes rabs brgya rtsa/ bka' brgyud gser phreng rnams kyi lung dang sngags bla med skor gyi dbang rab tu mang po zhus/ rje blo gros rgyal mtshan dang*/ bdud mo bkra shis 'od zer las sngags gsar rnying gi dbang lung mang po zhus/ dgung lo nyi shu bzhes dus rgyal ba'i dbang po'i drung nas bka' brgyud kyi gdam ngag kun zhus/ 'od phung dmar po'i dbus su rgyal ba'i dbang po nyid dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i skur bzhengs te dbang bskur/ mgon po ber can me dpung gi klong du gzigs/ dam can rdor legs 'khor ra mgo can dgra snying za ba mang pos bskor ba zhal gzigs/ ye shes mkha' 'gros glu dbyangs kyi sgra las/ bde chen rol pa zhes mtshan gsol zhing sman btsun gyi 'khor gyis phrin las sgrub par dam bcas/ mi bskyod zhabs kyi zhabs phyi mdzad nas dbus su phebs/ rgyal ba dkon mchog yan lag dang lhan cig dbang lung mang du gsan/ bya lo'i tho rangs khar dpal ye shes kyi mgon po sku mdog sngo skya me ri 'bar ba zhal gzigs/ khra ba khar rje'i drung nas rngog dkyil bdun dang bde mchog lo nag /zhang gi bka' rgya sogs dang zab khrid mang po zhus/ phyag rgya chen po'i ye shes mngon du gyur/ dgung lo nyer gsum la rje'i drung nas bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/ tho rangs zhig rje de bzhin gshegs pa/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ rang byung rdo rje rnams zhal gzigs/ sgar chen gyi gu'i gung par mnga' gsol/ za phu lung gi slob dpon chen po'i sku gu ru dngos su gzigs/ tshang ngos su dben par bzhugs tshe dam can gyis phrin las bsgrub pa gzigs/

zhabs rjes dang nyid kyi sku thang phyag bris ma mchod pa'i rten du bzhag ste ma 'ongs pa'i dus su sprul sku 'byon pa'i gnas su dgongs/ gro bo lung du bka' brgyud gong ma rnams zhal gzigs/ sham po steng du zhing skyong gis phrin las bsgrub par gzigs/ gnas de'i gangs 'dabs bsam 'grub bde chen du lo gsum gyi bcad rgyar bzhugs/ der bka' brgyud gong ma rnams dang yi dam chos skyong mang po zhal gzigs/ skye ba phyi mar 'dzam bu gling gi 'dul bya rnams pad+ma 'od kyi zhing khams su dgyes pa'i gad mo sgrog go zhes gsungs/ dgung lo so gcig pa me pho rta lor longs skur thim/ ༈¿¿dpal khang lo tsā ba ni/ rje nyid kyis karma phrin las gnyis par gnang ba ma gtogs mtshan dngos ngag dbang chos kyi rgyal po yin/ si tu chos kyi go cha dang*/ rgyal tshab grags pa don grub sogs kyi yongs 'dzin mdzad cing*/ bzo rig sgra snyan ngag sdeb sbyor bod brda sogs kyi slob ma dang slob rgyun ches mang*/ zhwa dmar bzhi pas rje a bo chos rje'i skye ba phyi mar lung bstan pa'i zur mkhar blo gros rgyal po la mdo sngags kyi bshad bka' du ma gnang ba dang lhag tu rje brgyad pas dus 'khor smin khrid btab/ gso rig la dpyis phyin par sbyongs shig gsungs nas ming legs bshad 'tshol du gnang*/ des kyang gso rig la mkhas par mdzad/ rgyud bzhi la zhus chen dang par du bkod nas 'grel pa mes zhal dang sman 'byung sogs gso rig gi bstan bcos du ma mdzad do// phrin las gnyis pa 'di rje brgyad pa'i dgongs pa lta ba thal 'gyur mdzad/ karma shing rta dang*/ rdo rje nyi snang sogs bstan bcos du ma mdzad/ thub chen dang mchims phu'i bla ma mdzad/ ༈¿¿sprul sku ba nam mkha' bkra shis ni/ yar stod du 'khrungs/ byis pa chung ngu'i dus nas rje nyid kyi sprul par zhal gyis bzhes/ sku gzugs kyi phrin las byed por lung bstan cing zhwa dmar lnga pas ljags bkod mdzad de sgar bris kyi srol btsugs pa'o//
༈¿¿dwags po sgo pa'i zhal ngo karma srid bral lam sgo smyon zhes pa ni/ rje nyid kyi sku'i sprul par grags pa des sgar lugs sku gzugs 'bur bzo'i srol btsugs pa yin no//
